• Team competencies are assessed, trained, and maintained to GPhC standards

• Controlled Drugs governance is robust, auditable, and scalable for growth

• You've led the pharmacy through a successful regulatory inspection or audit

• You've identified and influenced implementation of key technology or automation improvements

• You're actively shaping the pharmacy's clinical and regulatory strategy

 

What you'll be doing

 

Daily:

• Provide clinical leadership and ensure patient-centred governance

• Oversee pharmacy operations, staff competencies, and SOPs

• Maintain GPhC and MHRA compliance across all areas

• Manage Controlled Drugs records and governance

• Monitor medicines expenditure and suggest scalable improvements

• Support the team to maintain accuracy and pace simultaneously

Strategic:

• Shape clinical and governance strategy alongside senior leadership

• Evaluate new services and products for regulatory feasibility

• Lead regulatory readiness for business expansion

• Represent Montu with regulators and industry bodies

• Influence pharmacy technology and automation investments

• Support business growth through scalable governance frameworks

 

The Scope

 

You'll be responsible for:

• 50,000+ prescriptions per month (and growing 10% monthly)

• Millions of pounds of medicines under management annually

• Clinical oversight of a 100+ person pharmacy team

• Compliance across GPhC, MHRA, and all statutory regulations

• Controlled Drugs governance and audit

• Pharmacy systems and SOP governance

• Regulatory inspections and audit preparation

• Collaboration with clinical, operations, technology, and commercial teams

 

What we offer:

The salary range is £100,000 to £110,000 depending on experience, with a 25% performance-related bonus. Alongside that:

Benefits include:

• 25 days holiday, rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three, plus 8 bank holidays

• Private healthcare scheme

• Enhanced maternity and paternity leave

• Cycle-to-work and EV scheme

• Genuine growth: collaboration across teams, representation at industry events, and direct involvement in shaping a scaling business

title: Founding Engineer

description_html:
Fleetcraft builds the critical infrastructure for the next generation of aircraft.

Aerospace is in a once-in-a-lifetime transformation. OEMs have decade-long backlogs, new manufacturers are racing to market, and demand for spaceflight is surging. Meanwhile the industry is hundreds of thousands of technicians short, and the systems used to maintain and manufacture aircraft are slow, manual, and largely unchanged in decades.

We're building the systems that work alongside technicians, understand the aircraft, and keep the hangar moving.

Our team has helped launch airlines and put satellites into orbit. Our aviation advisory board has run major aircraft OEMs, led airworthiness at Gulfstream, and overseen training facilities that educate a quarter of all aircraft mechanics in the US.

Susa Ventures led our seed alongside Liquid 2 VC, early backers of Anduril and Stoke Space. We've raised a $5.3M seed round and are on track for our Series A.

What you'll do

You'll build and scale the core systems aircraft technicians use every day: deciding the architecture, writing the code, and sitting in the hangar watching people use it.

  • Build and scale the core systems that aircraft MROs rely on every day.

  • Build AI agent systems end-to-end, from voice interfaces on the hangar floor to workflow orchestration across maintenance operations.

  • Own projects from architecture to deployment, with autonomy over technical decisions.

  • Own reliability: infrastructure, observability, and evals for AI in a regulated industry.

  • Turn aerospace data into trusted pipelines, from maintenance manuals and work orders to airworthiness directives and parts catalogues.

  • Stay at the frontier by adopting new model capabilities and improving the team's tooling.

  • Talk to technicians, maintenance managers, and regulators, then turn what you learn into product decisions.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of full-stack experience.

  • Ability to build high-quality software fast.

  • A co-owner mindset. We'll give you the customer context and the autonomy to find the best path forward, and expect you to own the outcome.

  • You learn fast. Aerospace experience isn't required.

  • You're pragmatic and structured.

Strong plus: Early-stage experience, competitive programming, trading, building agents.

Tech stack: FastAPI · Pydantic · TypeScript · React · OpenAI / Anthropic · PostgreSQL · Turbopuffer · Promptfoo · Azure

What we offer

£100k–£130k salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.
Modern tools, real-world impact in a regulated industry, and the chance to define how AI transforms aerospace from the ground up.

We are a small, high-trust team where your decisions move the whole company forward. If you're energised by building production AI systems that solve hard, real-world problems - and you want the ownership and pace that only comes from being early at something important, we'd love to talk.


We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
Fleetcraft is an equal opportunities employer.

  • Review and analyse user stories, requirements, and technical specifications, working closely with developers and product managers to identify gaps, ambiguity, or potential issues before development starts

  • Work with other QAs and engineers to improve testing tooling, coverage, and approach across the team as a whole

Required Experience

  • 4+ years in software QA with a focus on automation testing.

  • Hands-on experience building automated tests spanning web, mobile (iOS and Android) and API layers with Playwright and Appium.

  • Experience testing pure API products, using tools like Postman and Swagger.

  • Proven experience defining a product test strategy as a whole.

  • Using agentic AI tooling to accelerate the creation and maintenance of automated tests.

Nice to have (but we can teach you)

  • Experience in working within a regulated SSDLC process

Software Engineer

Office Location: Temple, London - Hybrid (3 days/week in office)

Experience Level: +3 years commercial software engineering experience

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that.

 

So far, we have raised £3.5 million in funding, secured direct regulatory approval from the FCA, and picked up two major awards in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) and Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN). Having launched on iOS - reaching 4,000+ total sign-ups - we have now just launched on Android, doubling our addressable market as we scale toward targets of 10,000 users, 100,000, and expand across Europe.

 

Key Platform Traction:

  • 8,000+ trades processed

  • 2,500+ early supporters rewarded for their loyalty

  • 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • 150+ 5-star reviews

Our goal is straightforward: Think Options, Think Investa.

 

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

The Role

The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch, and we’re now looking for a driven Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.

Having passed the junior stage of your career, you bring over 3 years of commercial experience writing clean code and shipping features independently. In this role, you will take true end-to-end ownership of core platform features, work across our stack, and step outside your comfort zone to level up your technical depth alongside our talented engineering team of 4.

If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex financial challenges and you excel in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we want to hear from you.

What the Role Involves

  • Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders without corporate red tape, , you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.

  • Building the Engineering Culture: Joining our founding engineering team means you are actively building our engineering culture, not just stepping into one. You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.

  • Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.

  • System Design & Architectural Contribution: Partnering directly with the engineering team to tackle complex systems design and actively shape our evolving architecture. Your technical perspective will give you a strong voice in our high-level design choices. You will have true design ownership over the specific services and components you build, ensuring they remain robust, secure, and performant as we scale.

  • Technical Excellence: Maintaining a high bar for code quality, testing, and documentation. You’ll participate in (and contribute to) meaningful code reviews.

  • System Integrity: Monitoring and improving system reliability, ensuring our trading platform is always "always-on."

  • Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship

Your Background

  • Experience: +3 years of commercial software engineering experience, ideally with experience building or maintaining distributed systems or backend APIs.

  • Hands-on Coder: You are a strong practitioner who loves shipping clean, readable code and takes pride in seeing features go live.

  • Tech Stack Proficiency: Proficient in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go) and comfortable working within cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Pragmatic Mindset: You understand the balance between elegant code and delivering real value to users in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Curious & First-Principles Thinker: You enjoy dissecting how systems work under the hood and are ready to quickly pick up domain concepts like options pricing, execution mechanics, and financial regulations.

On-call

All engineers at Investa participate in supporting our production applications. This involves responding to critical system events outside of working hours and ensuring our platform stays dependable.

What we offer:

Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.

Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.

The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

Compensation and Benefits

Financial Growth 💸

  • Base Salary: £60,000 - £85,000 per annum, commensurate with experience.

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.2% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

  • Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track.

Health & Wellbeing 🌴🦷

  • Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off.

  • Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa.

Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕

  • The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by you. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook Pro and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening with Talent Lead

  • Stage 2: Technical & Architectural Deep Dive

  • Stage 3: Coding/Systems Design Interview

  • Stage 4: Final Behavioural interview

  • Offer

Looking at both our Senior and Mid-Level roles?

Please choose the single position that best matches your current experience and apply once. Our hiring team cross-reviews all engineering applications, so if the other level turns out to be a better fit, we’ll automatically switch your application.

What We’re All About.

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organizations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for a diligent and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Assistant to join our dynamic finance team.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The Opportunity.

As an Accounts Payable Assistant, you will be a vital part of the team that keeps our financial engine running smoothly. You will be responsible for ensuring our suppliers are paid accurately and on time, maintaining strong relationships, and supporting the integrity of our financial data. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your finance career within a fast-paced, high-growth global technology company.

What You’ll Be Doing.

  • Processing a high volume of supplier invoices with exceptional accuracy, ensuring they are correctly coded and authorised.

  • Performing three-way matching of invoices to purchase orders and receipts.

  • Preparing and processing weekly payment runs for multiple currencies and entities.

  • Acting as a primary point of contact for supplier queries, resolving issues professionally and efficiently.

  • Reconciling supplier statements and investigating and resolving any discrepancies.

  • Assisting the AP team with month-end close procedures and accruals.

  • Championing best practices by encouraging the use of our Procure-to-Pay (P2P) systems across the business.

What You’ll Bring.

  • Experience: You have previous experience working in an Accounts Payable or a similar transactional finance role.

  • Attention to Detail: You have meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

  • Organisational Skills: You are highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • A Proactive Mindset: You are a proactive, positive, and collaborative team player with strong problem-solving skills.

  • Communication: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Systems: You are proficient in Microsoft Excel.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience working within a high-growth tech or SaaS company.

  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems like NetSuite and spend management tools like Navan or Expensify.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Head of Brand Marketing
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Goodlord
description_html:
📍 London (Hybrid – 2 days in office, 3 days remote/WFH or office if you prefer!)

Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. At Goodlord, our mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting - simplifying complexity across agents, landlords and tenants.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Brand to own how Goodlord shows up in the world - from our brand and content to PR, corporate affairs and thought leadership.

This is a role for someone who brings together brand ownership and PR/communications. You’ll have experience owning and shaping a B2B brand - its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market - alongside strong, hands-on PR and media experience.

You’ll have built that experience within B2B technology/SaaS, or in a PR and communications agency working with B2B technology clients. That combination is important: we need someone who is as comfortable thinking about our brand and positioning as they are shaping a story, working with journalists and building our reputation.

Reporting directly to our Marketing Director, you’ll lead a team of four across content, SEO and design, manage our external PR agency and work closely with colleagues across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and the wider business.

You’ll help make Goodlord a distinctive and trusted voice in the industry, turning complex topics - from regulation and policy to AI and technology - into stories people actually want to read, hear and talk about.

If you like autonomy, pace and variety - and you’re comfortable being the person who both shapes what great looks like and helps make it happen - this could be a great fit!

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Owning our brand - shaping and evolving Goodlord’s positioning, messaging, identity and voice, and making sure we show up consistently and distinctively

  • Leading PR, media and corporate affairs - owning our day-to-day PR and media activity, building relationships with journalists, spotting and shaping stories, managing our external PR agency and leading our approach to regulatory, policy and reputation-related communications

  • Shaping our stories - turning complex industry, regulatory and technology topics into compelling narratives and thought leadership, working with senior leaders where needed

  • Leading content and SEO - setting the direction for our content and SEO specialists, helping them create useful, engaging work that supports our brand and wider business priorities

  • Leading creative and design - setting clear direction for our in-house designers and making sure everything we put into the world feels unmistakably Goodlord

  • Connecting brand to the business - partnering with Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales to make sure brand, PR and content support our wider commercial goals

ABOUT YOU

You’ll be well suited to this role if you:

  • Have strong commercial experience across brand and PR/communications, gained within B2B technology/SaaS or a PR and communications agency working with B2B technology clients, or a mix of both!

  • Have owned and shaped a brand - its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market - rather than solely delivering brand campaigns or driving brand awareness

  • Have strong, hands-on PR and media experience, with a track record of building journalist relationships, shaping stories and delivering earned coverage

  • Are a strong storyteller with sound strategic judgement, able to zoom out to brand strategy and zoom in to a single headline

  • Have experience across corporate affairs, reputation management and thought leadership, including working with senior leaders on external communications

  • Have experience directly leading and developing individual contributors, with the judgement to set direction across content, SEO and creative

  • Are commercially minded, collaborative and enjoy having ownership while staying close to the work

This role is about owning delivery, not building a large function. If you’re looking for a purely strategic communications role with a sizeable team underneath you, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you enjoy being close to the work and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you!

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

title: Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Finom
description_html:
Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design

About the Role

Finom is building a brand that European entrepreneurs recognise and trust, and right now the visual side of that brand needs an owner.

We are looking for an Art Director to lead our Marketing Design team and take ownership of Finom's visual identity end to end. Not marketing design in isolation: the brand system itself, the guidelines behind it, and how consistently it shows up everywhere Finom appears.

You are joining at a genuine inflection point. Finom is growing fast, helping entrepreneurs around Europe take their businesses to the next level. We have over 200k users with ambition for millions more. Meanwhile, our customers rate us 4.8 on Trustpilot, the only business banking app above 4.7.

Our ambition brings with it a unique set of challenges. Your job will be twofold: raise the creative bar, and build the system that lets a team deliver at volume without the quality dropping.

Your first months will be as much about diagnosis as creation: auditing the existing identity, understanding where the current team and workflows are working or falling short, and putting the foundations in place for what comes next. From there, you'll help determine and lead the next evolution of Finom's visual identity.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will direct and mentor, and you will also design, setting the visual benchmark yourself, not just reviewing other people's work against it. You will work in close partnership with our VP of Product Design, so that the brand reads as one across marketing, product, and the entire brand experience.

Finom is building an AI-native production pipeline, and we want a creative leader who is already fluent in it. Not someone curious about AI, someone who has shipped with it and can design the workflows, quality gates and brand guardrails that make AI output genuinely good rather than merely fast.

What You Will Be Doing

•  Own Finom's visual identity (the brand system, guidelines, design systems and documentation) and drive consistent adoption across every team and touchpoint, including teams that produce assets outside your own

•  Set and hold the creative bar. Shape visual direction across channels and make consistency and quality non-negotiable

•  Lead and develop the existing Marketing Design team, assess its capabilities and future shape, and determine where additional permanent, freelance or AI-enabled capacity is needed

•  Define the design requirements for intake, briefing, prioritisation, SLAs and review, working with Brand Operations and Marketing Operations to turn them into scalable processes

•  Design and direct high-quality visual and motion assets that bring the brand to life, personally setting the benchmark for the wider team

•  Build the AI-native production pipeline: define where AI accelerates the work, where it doesn't, and what quality and brand-integrity gates it has to pass. Create the templates, systems and tools that let both designers and AI workflows execute independently

•  Provide creative direction at the front of significant projects (the creative kickoff, the concept, the narrative) rather than reviewing work once it's already been produced

•  Direct the creation of mood boards, design references, scamps, storyboards and animatics to communicate creative intent

•  Partner with Marketing, Product, copywriters and strategists to develop campaigns across digital-first channels (social, web, video), with the ability to stretch into ATL where the moment calls for it

•  Own projects from concept through delivery, and run multiple parallel workstreams without letting standards slip

•  Build and present creative work to senior stakeholders, articulating rationale clearly enough to guide decisions

•  Manage a flexible pool of freelance and external creative partners to absorb peaks in demand

•  Act as guardian of the visual identity while continuously pushing where the brand can be braver

Who You Are

•  A genuinely strong designer. Other designers respect your work and want to learn from you; that's the bar, and it isn't optional for this role

•  Strong design taste, and able to articulate how it impacts the business. You can tell excellent from generic and explain precisely why, in terms a non-designer can act on

•  A builder of process as much as a maker of work. You believe high volume and high quality are compatible, and you have the systems thinking to prove it

•  Customer-obsessed in how you approach brand: your creative decisions trace back to what the audience actually responds to, not to internal taste

•  Comfortable with ambiguity. Finom is moving fast, the setup is being built as you go, and you find that energising rather than exhausting

•  A generous leader who elevates people, gives direct feedback, and turns good work into exceptional work

•  Confident with senior stakeholders without becoming a bottleneck for them

Must-Haves

•  8+ years as a graphic or brand designer, ideally in fast-moving, brand-led environments

•  4+ years as a design leader with direct responsibility for a team of three or more

•  Experience building customer-facing technology brands or consumer digital products at scale. Your portfolio should show how strong visual craft works alongside usability, clarity and commercial objectives

•  A track record of building and evolving brand systems across campaigns, products or businesses, including ownership of key visual directions

•  A standout portfolio showing strategic thinking, creativity and polished execution across visual design, motion, editorial, digital and social formats

•  Clear examples of work where you led or directed other creatives

•  Demonstrated AI design fluency, with evidence of AI-native production rather than occasional AI assistance: workflows you built, quality standards you set, output you shipped

•  Experience creating scalable brand systems, templates, tools and guidelines that let other teams execute independently

•  Expertise across Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma, with the ability to define efficient workflows and standards for a team

•  A portfolio of shipped brand assets: campaign visuals, social graphics, presentation decks, event materials, marketing collateral

•  Excellent communication skills and the judgement to influence at a senior level

•  Fluent English

Nice-to-Haves

•  Experience in fintech or financial services

•  Experience with sponsorship, partnership or event-led brand work at scale

•  Motion design depth, or experience directing motion specialists

•  Experience partnering closely with a product design function on a shared brand system

•  Experience building and managing a freelance or external creative network

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Our teams play a vital role in making pet healthcare more accessible through innovation, operational excellence, and outstanding customer experience. 

 

 

 

 

 


How You'll Make a Difference

You'll report to the Managing Director and lead the supply chain for Pet Drugs Online (PDOL), giving the business one clear view of demand, supply, stock and risk. You'll own the sales and operations planning (S&OP) process and lead three managers, covering planning, stock, and our carrier and third party logistics (3PL) partners. The goal is easy to state and hard to achieve: the right stock in the right place at the right time, without losing sales or tying up cash in excess or obsolete inventory.

  • Run the monthly S&OP cycle from demand review through to the executive decision meeting, and chair the weekly reviews that keep the plan on track between cycles
  • Build one agreed demand forecast by product, category and time horizon, then track its accuracy and bias and challenge any assumption without evidence behind it
  • Turn the demand plan into a workable supply, purchasing, stock and warehouse capacity plan, making constraints, costs and the effect on customers clear before anything is approved
  • Set stock policy for each product segment, covering service levels, safety stock, reorder points and order quantities, with separate controls for fast and slow movers and for prescription, seasonal, short dated and critical lines
  • Hold overall accountability for stock accuracy and availability, working through the Stock Manager on counts, batch and expiry control, adjustments and fixing root causes
  • Manage supplier performance and own the commercial relationships with our carriers and 3PL partners, from contracts and service levels to capacity and contingency plans
  • Work with Commercial on ranges and promotions, with Finance to reconcile the plan to budget and working capital, and with Goods In and Warehouse Operations to keep inbound deliveries manageable
  • Build the team's capability, succession and reporting so the function spots problems early and doesn't have to rush orders through after the fact

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

We're looking for a driven, capable professional who brings:

  • Senior supply chain leadership experience, including direct ownership of S&OP, demand and supply planning, purchasing and inventory in a business with a large, varied product range
  • Deep practical knowledge of forecast accuracy and bias, inventory segmentation, safety stock, reorder logic, supplier lead times, service levels and working capital
  • Strong commercial and financial judgement, with the ability to put numbers on the choices between revenue, margin, availability, cost, cash and risk
  • Confidence chairing decision meetings with Commercial, Operations and Finance, challenging constructively and getting everyone behind one plan

You will act as a trusted advisor to Commercial and cross-functional leadership, bringing together financial, market and operational insights to challenge assumptions, evaluate strategic choices and improve the quality of commercial decision-making across the organisation. 

Key responsibilities: 

Commercial Performance & Planning 

  • Establish and own weekly, monthly and quarterly business review reporting, translating performance trends into strategic insights, risks, opportunities and recommended  actions for senior leadership. 

  • Define and develop, in partnership with Product & Finance  1-3 year commercial capacity, growth and productivity models. 

  • Own annual and quarterly commercial planning, aligned with Corporate Strategy and FP&A. 

  • Define and evolve territory, segmentation and coverage models across regions and customer segments. 

  • Partner with the designated Finance business partner to translate commercial plans into agreed budgets and forecasts, challenging assumptions and ensuring financial plans accurately reflect commercial strategy, capacity requirements and expected performance. 

Quotas, Incentives & Pricing 

  • Develop quota methodologies and provide expert input into sales incentive design with Sales leadership, Finance and RevOps. 

  • Build pricing analytics and recommendations, partnering with Offering Management to inform and  evolve pricing models. 

  • Analyse realised pricing, discounting, margins, deal economics, exceptions and offer mix, identifying systemic trends and recommending changes that improve commercial performance and decision-making. 

  • Lead quarterly pricing reviews and track agreed pricing model improvements through implementation to measure commercial impact. 

  • Develop frameworks and decision criteria for evaluating complex commercial trade-offs across price, margin, growth, capacity, and strategic value. 

Commercial Insight 

  • Model cost, benefit, ROI/payback and key assumptions for headcount, technology, geographic expansion and route-to-market decisions. 

  • Analyse productivity, conversion, win/loss and commercial performance trends, identifying underlying drivers and translating findings into recommendations for senior leadership. 

  • Provide evidence-based recommendations on where and how the commercial organisation should invest and scale. 

  • Lead complex analytical work on new or ambiguous commercial questions where established methodologies or precedents may not exist. 

  • Evaluate external market, competitive and internal performance signals to identify implications for commercial strategy and planning assumptions. 

Must Have:

  • Significant experience in Commercial Planning, Strategy & Operations, Business Planning, FP&A, Revenue Operations or a similar analytical role, including experience advising senior leadership on complex commercial decisions. 

  • Exceptional analytical and financial-modelling capability. 

  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales economics, capacity planning and commercial productivity. 

  • Experience with territory, quota and incentive modelling. 

  • Experience analysing pricing, discounting and commercial models, and translating analysis into actionable commercial recommendations. 

  • Strong business-case and scenario-modelling skills. 

  • Ability to translate complex analysis into concise executive recommendations. 

We value:  

  • Experience supporting global commercial organisations spanning multiple regions, customer segments or routes to market. 

  • Experience supporting major growth, market-entry, organisational scaling or commercial transformation initiatives.

description_html:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY  

We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.

Based in Cologne, you'll be a key member of the Engineering team building IMPECT's customer-facing Scouting and Analytics platforms. You'll develop backend services and frontend features that help football clubs explore our data, evaluate players and teams, and analyse performance. Your work will span data-rich interfaces, interactive visualisations, integrated video tools, and workflows that support scouting and match analysis. Working closely with Product and fellow engineers, you'll translate customer needs into intuitive, reliable applications and help improve their performance and scalability as our platform grows. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll contribute to technical decisions and take ownership of features from initial design through to delivery, shaping the products our customers use every day.

We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance.  Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Build and maintain Angular web applications
  • Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications
  • Design and implement database schema
  • Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications
  • Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.
  • Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features
  • Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.
  • Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • At least 5 years of software development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin Java.
  • Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema
  • Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications
  • Experience with Git code management is highly desired.

Other Requirements:

  • Very strong attention to detail.
  • Proven self-starter.
  • Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to prioritise and a "can-do" attitude.
  • Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability 
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better.  There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

description_html:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)

Language requirement: fluency in German or Spanish

Location: Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

Employment: 18-month FTC with view to extend

 

About the role: 

We're hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You'll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You'll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren't there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you'll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

 

Key Responsibilities:

New Business and Client Engagement

  • Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
  • Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
  • Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren't present, and know when and how to bring them in.
  • Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis

  • Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
  • Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
  • Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design

  • Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
  • Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
  • Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
  • Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling

  • Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
  • Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
  • Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
  • Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting

  • Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
  • Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

 

About You:

Essential

  • 10-15 years' experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
  • A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
  • Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
  • A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
  • Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
  • Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren't in the room.
  • Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable

  • Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
  • Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
  • Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

 

What Success Looks Like:

  • Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
  • Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
  • Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
  • Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Deliveroo
description_html:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us build and operate the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

Get to know our Engineering team, what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, EventBus and related streaming platforms.

  • Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges.

  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.

  • Contribute to incident response, operational readiness and continuous improvement for Tier-0 infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with EventBus, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams across US and EU regions.

  • Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo's event streaming platform.

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.

  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.

  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.

  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.

  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.

  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.

 

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create
Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine, our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide to help you feel confident at each stage.

 

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

description_html:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Focused Energy is developing its flagship fusion facility at Biblis, Germany — and this role sits at the heart of making it happen. As Facility Development Lead, you will be the senior bridge between our engineering teams, the RWE/Biblis site stakeholders, German design and permitting requirements, utilities providers, and external planning partners.

Without this role, Biblis development would slow down, RWE discussions would be less focused, and facility requirements could become fragmented. Engineering leaders would carry too much of the facility strategy and stakeholder interface burden. You will remove that risk by owning the facility development direction end-to-end.

Your primary mission: turn Focused Energy’s technical and strategic needs for Biblis into a clear, realistic, and executable facility development plan — and keep it moving.

What You'll Do

Define the Biblis facility development direction by translating FE’s technical

requirements into a phased, executable site, building, and infrastructure plan.

• Lead the RWE and site-owner interface on facility planning, infrastructure constraints,

utilities, and long-term site expansion, collaborating closely with the Senior

Construction Project Manager.

• Translate engineering’s needs into facility requirements across lasers, targetry,

diagnostics, controls, cleanrooms, electrical systems, safety and operations.

• Drive German design and permitting strategy by identifying required approvals,

regulatory constraints, fire protection requirements, and risk assessment.

• Coordinate external architects, planners, consultants and utilities partners, ensuring

their output is aligned with FE’s technical roadmap and decision needs.

• Enable senior decision-making by maintaining a clear, current picture of facility options,

risks, assumptions, dependencies, and cost/schedule implications, so engineering

leadership can act with confidence and without delay.

Who You Are

Must-haves

  • Experience leading or shaping complex facility, industrial building, infrastructure, or technical site development in Germany.

  • Working knowledge of German building, planning, permitting, and compliance processes.

  • Ability to translate technical engineering needs into facility, layout, infrastructure, and utility requirements.

  • Ability to manage external architects, planners, consultants, or engineering service providers.

  • Strong stakeholder interface experience with site owners, authorities, landlords, utilities, or senior external partners.

  • Professional German and English language capability.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with energy, nuclear-adjacent, research, cleanroom, laser, laboratory, or high-tech industrial facilities.

  • Direct experience with RWE, grid operators, utilities providers, or major German site owners.

  • Experience with phased campus or brownfield site development.

  • Familiarity with power infrastructure, backup power, grid connection, HVAC, cooling, cleanrooms, or specialist utilities.

  • Architectural, civil, building services, industrial engineering, or related professional qualification.

  • Experience supporting investment cases, board-level decision papers, or strategic facility roadmaps.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

description_html:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, you’ll build core features for our flagship product, turning complex tax scenarios into simple, reliable experiences. You’ll bring a builder-first mindset: staying close to customer problems, using AI and modern engineering tools to move from idea to impact quickly, and taking ownership of outcomes—not just code.

You’ll work hands-on in a cross-functional team and bring deep expertise in either frontend or backend engineering, while collaborating effectively across the stack. You’ll help us raise the bar for scalable design, quality, maintainability, and AI-first software development.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Partner with product management, design, and engineering to understand customer problems, shape pragmatic solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Own work end to end—from discovery and technical design through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Turn ambiguity into action, make sound trade-offs, and deliver valuable increments without compromising long-term maintainability.

  • Contribute to technical direction and strategy in support of the long-term product vision.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Critically evaluate, validate, and troubleshoot AI-generated output, using effective prompting and appropriate safeguards rather than accepting results at face value.

  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices, encourage responsible experimentation, and help teammates improve how they use AI tools.

  • Improve developer experience through tools, automation, and engineering practices that enable reliable, frequent delivery.

  • Collaborate across product and platform teams, and contribute to an environment where people learn, grow, give constructive feedback, and raise challenges safely.

Your profile:

  • Professional software engineering experience (React, Node.js) and designing reliable backend services and APIs. Experience with React Native experience is a plus.

  • Able to work effectively across system boundaries and collaborate with engineers outside your primary specialism.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Able to evaluate and troubleshoot AI-generated output, use effective prompting where relevant, and share practical learnings with teammates.

  • Experience working with a public cloud environment such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.

  • Familiarity with DevOps concepts and practices, including CI/CD, observability, and operating software in production.

  • Understanding of core application and backend concepts such as authentication, databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations.

  • A builder-first, pragmatic approach: You turn customer problems into shipped outcomes. You take initiative, test and learn quickly, and make clear trade-offs between speed, quality, maintainability, and risk.

  • Passion for writing maintainable, elegant code and continuously improving how software is built.

  • A collaborative, positive attitude and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively.

  • You have a builder mindset. You thrive in environments where things are still taking shape, take initiative to move ideas forward, and find ways to create impact even when the path isn't fully defined.

  • You embrace trying things out over waiting for perfect conditions, ship early to learn fast, and treat iteration as progress.

 

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

title: Senior Information Security Manager (EU Sovereignty)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at DeepL
description_html:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is looking for a Senior Information Security Manager to strengthen our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) function. You'll own the day-to-day operation of our information security and compliance program, with a strong focus on ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, and a bonus if you bring HIPAA or BSI C5 experience to the table.

This isn't a "gatekeeper" role. We're a SaaS scale-up, and our product teams move fast. We need someone who understands risk well enough to take calculated ones, someone who can say "yes, and here's how we do it safely" instead of defaulting to "no." You'll be the person who keeps compliance moving at the speed of the business, not the person who slows it down.

You'll be part of our Information Security team, sitting within the broader Security track alongside the IT Security team, both under our Head of Security. You'll work closely with your teammates in Information Security and IT Security to make sure security and compliance work hand in hand rather than in separate lanes.

 

Your responsibilities

Program ownership

  • Own and continuously improve our Information Security Management System (ISMS), keeping it aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and, where relevant, HIPAA and BSI C5

  • Maintain and mature our risk register, policy library, vendor/third-party risk assessments, and control monitoring

Audits & evidence

  • Act as a hands-on participant in audits, working directly with auditors, control owners, and leadership to prepare, execute, and close out certification and attestation cycles efficiently rather than through brute force

  • Build and refine evidence collection processes using automation and GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or similar), reducing manual overhead and audit fatigue across the company

  • Design and roll out a model where product and engineering teams own their evidence throughout the control lifecycle, rather than compliance chasing people down before every audit

Risk & business partnership

  • Assess risk pragmatically: identify real security and compliance exposure, size it accurately, and make calculated calls that unblock product and engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering, product, IT, People, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into existing workflows rather than bolting them on afterward

  • Track regulatory and customer-driven compliance requirements — new customer security questionnaires, evolving frameworks — and translate them into practical, actionable controls

Reporting

  • Report on the state of the security and compliance program to stakeholders and leadership, including audit readiness, open risks, and remediation progress

 

Qualities we look for

  • 3-5 years of experience in information security, GRC, or compliance roles, ideally at a SaaS company, and ideally at scaleup pace and scale

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs and audits, from control design through evidence collection to certification

  • Experience with HIPAA and/or BSI C5 is a strong plus

  • Practical experience with GRC/evidence automation tooling such as Vanta (or equivalent), including building smooth, low-friction processes around it

  • A track record of building processes that shift evidence ownership to the teams generating the evidence, rather than centralizing it all in compliance

  • Sound risk judgment: comfortable making calculated, defensible risk decisions to keep product teams unblocked, rather than reflexively blocking

  • Strong stakeholder management skills; able to work credibly with engineers, product managers, and leadership without becoming an obstacle

  • Fluent English and German language skills at C1 level (or close by) are required

  • Clear, structured communicator who can translate compliance requirements into language engineering and product teams actually act on

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-HK1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
