About the Role:

The Communications team at Hims & Hers is responsible for shaping how the world understands our company’s role in advancing modern health. We develop strategies to raise awareness, increase brand love, build trust and loyalty, and drive adoption of our products and services. As Hers, our platform for women’s health, scales its product portfolio and enters new health categories, the Director, Product Communications, Hers will lead and develop strategies to raise awareness, increase brand love, build trust and loyalty, and drive adoption. You will shape how we position and communicate our products and care offerings across media, internal teams, influencer and editorial channels, and key external moments.

In this role, you’ll lead high-priority initiatives across consumer product, brand, and executive communications. Reporting to the VP of Product & International Communications, you’ll work closely with senior members of the Communications team and our cross-functional partners in marketing, clinical, product, social, and customer insights to position Hers as a leader in women’s health.

We’re a team of intellectually curious, creative storytellers and problem solvers. You love making the complex simple and the abstract resonate. You thrive working in the fast pace of a startup while being the steward of a public company that serves people’s health and well being. You can identify areas of risk and opportunity for our narrative, and you bring experience thinking holistically about brand vision and direct-to-consumer experience.

You Will:

  • Lead Hers product communications across defined categories, with accountability for business impact including awareness, trust, and adoption

  • Influence Hers product positioning and go-to-market decisions in partnership with Product, Growth, Clinical, Regulatory, Brand and Product Marketing

  • Lead earned media strategy and execution tied to Hers product priorities, including proactive storytelling and reactive engagement

  • Drive how Hers products show up across editorial moments, influencer activations, and key external events

  • Ensure alignment across external and internal communications so teams operate from a consistent and accurate product narrative

  • Build deep expertise in Hers products and represent the company directly with media, partners, and key stakeholders

  • Develop and drive thought leadership across physicians, patient communities, and broader healthcare audiences for Hers.

  • Lead communications for new category expansion in emerging areas of women’s health, and diagnostics, including positioning and launch execution

  • Lead issue management within Hers product categories, driving clear positioning and response in complex or high-visibility situations

  • Translate clinical, regulatory, and product complexity into messaging that is clear, accurate, and defensible

  • Design and execute integrated communications campaigns tied to product priorities, with clear measurement of impact on awareness, trust, and adoption

  • Track performance, evaluate results, and adjust strategy based on what drives impact

  • Drive planning, prioritization, and execution discipline within your scope

  • Collaborate with the Corporate Communications team on issues management tied to product and category topics, including high-scrutiny areas, ensuring clear, credible, and timely responses

You Have:

  • 10–12+ years of experience in product communications, consumer communications, or related fields

  • Strong understanding of DTC product-led businesses, including how product, growth, and customer behavior connect

  • Experience leveraging AI tools and strategies to enhance team and communications performance

  • Experience owning a defined area of responsibility end-to-end, including shaping direction and driving execution

  • Strong earned media experience, with a track record of landing stories and building sustained narratives

  • Experience working across media, influencer, editorial, and event-driven communications

  • Experience in consumer health or other consumer-facing industries with regulatory or reputational complexity

  • Strong consumer instincts, with the ability to translate product value into messaging that resonates with real users

  • Experience leading issue management within a defined scope, with strong judgment in fast-moving or ambiguous situations

  • Data-driven mindset, with the ability to define success, measure performance, and adjust based on impact

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to influence Product, Growth, Clinical, and Executive stakeholders

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

title: Account Manager (Remote - Mexico)
description_html:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We also offer:

  • Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it paid time off
  • A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

Role Overview:

As an Associate, Account Management, you oversee and manage relationships with high-value Pros, ensuring their continued success and growth. You focus on supporting existing accounts, driving account expansion, and selling add-on products to maximize revenue potential. With a portfolio of approximately 100–130 Pros, you build strong, trust-based relationships by delivering consultative, tailored solutions aligned to each Pro’s business goals. You take a proactive, customer-focused approach to retention, identifying opportunities to increase engagement, strengthen partnerships, and drive measurable growth across your book of business.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Our success is their success.

What you do each day:

  • Establish, manage, and nurture long-term relationships with Pros to drive engagement, satisfaction, and account growth
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your portfolio, ensuring clear communication, goal alignment, and timely follow-through
  • Support contract renewal efforts by proactively addressing concerns, reinforcing value, and strengthening long-term partnerships
  • Identify and execute opportunities to grow accounts through consultative upselling and cross-selling of add-on products
  • Provide ongoing support to ensure Pros have a seamless and successful experience with our company’s solutions
  • Analyze account performance, customer behavior, and product usage data to recommend strategies that optimize retention and expansion
  • Manage and maintain account-specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure consistency and scalability
  • Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews to assess needs and present solutions aligned with each Pro’s goals
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Support teams to deliver a cohesive customer experience
  • Meet and exceed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to renewals, expansion

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years of experience in account management, customer success, sales, or customer support within a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment
  • Experience managing mid-market accounts ($20K–$200K Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)) with a focus on retention and expansion
  • Proficiency using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems (i.e. Salesforce) for account tracking, reporting, and pipeline management
  • Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills grounded in data and customer insights
  • Experience using AI tools to increase quality and efficiency of work
  • Ability to manage a portfolio of 100–130 accounts while maintaining organization and attention to detail
  • Experience contributing feedback to improve processes and workflows in evolving environments
  • Contractor or home services industry experience is a plus

What will help you succeed in this role:

  • Strong emotional intelligence and empathy to build lasting, trust-based relationships
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with advanced professional fluency in English
  • Self-motivated and results-driven mindset focused on growth and performance
  • Ability to think strategically about account success while executing tactically
  • Proactive approach to identifying opportunities for improvement and expansion
  • Growth mindset with enthusiasm for contributing ideas that enhance team processes and the Pro experience

Location Dependent Information
This role is open to candidates and the expected compensation range for this role is $34,000-$38,000USD annually. The specific hourly rate for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. #LI-Remote

All final hiring and engagement decisions are made by human representatives, not AI tools.

Any specific metrics, targets, or performance goals referenced in this posting are illustrative only and are subject to change based on evolving business needs.

title: Chief Actuary
description_html:
The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions—from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.

As a Chief Actuary, you will:

  • Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.
  • Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure.
  • Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead the annual Medicare Advantage bid strategy and pricing process, framing tradeoffs among growth, competitiveness, margin, risk, and capital requirements to support enterprise planning and executive decision-making.
  • Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.
  • Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.
  • Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.
  • Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense.
  • Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain actuarial governance, model review, documentation, control, and validation standards that support regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and sound executive decision-making.

Success in this role looks like:

First 90 Days

  • Build trusted relationships across Finance and key business partners.
  • Assess the current actuarial organization, tools, and operating model.
  • Develop a roadmap for AI adoption and workflow automation across the actuarial function.
  • Gain deep familiarity with Clover's pricing, forecasting, reserving, and medical economics processes.

First 6 Months

  • Begin implementing AI-enabled actuarial workflows that improve efficiency and insight generation.
  • Strengthen forecasting, reserving, and bid processes through improved automation and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Successfully assume ownership of additional actuarial responsibilities, including reserve oversight and governance.
  • Establish a clear long-term organizational vision for the actuarial function.

Long Term

  • Build one of the industry's most modern actuarial organizations by combining deep actuarial science with AI-enabled decision support.
  • Improve forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and enterprise decision-making through advanced analytics and automation.
  • Develop a highly engaged, high-performing actuarial team that is recognized as a strategic partner across the organization.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) and a Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
  • You have significant leadership experience in Medicare Advantage actuarial functions, including pricing, reserving, forecasting, and bid development.
  • You are an AI evangelist and have demonstrated experience deploying AI workflows across your functional areas. Moreover, you are enthusiastic about applying automation and modern tooling to fundamentally improve the actuarial function.
  • You have experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives that influence executive decision-making.
  • You are equally comfortable discussing actuarial methodology with technical experts and communicating business implications to executives and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have a track record of building, mentoring, and developing high-performing actuarial teams.
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments where you can build, innovate, and shape the future of an organization.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Lead Product Manager
description_html:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is at an inflection point. We've built dozens of categories that people love, and we're great at the treatments themselves. But today those are dozens of separate, transactional relationships. The opportunity in front of us is to invert that: to move from point solutions to one deepening relationship with each customer, where we understand them holistically across all of their concerns, help them navigate what to do, and let the individual treatments become secondary to the relationship itself.

That shift is what this role owns. It's a true 0-to-1 build, but not a cold start. You'll define a brand-new, relationship-first product experience that spans our existing categories and the new ones we create to support it, with everything we've already built as your foundation. Picture a concierge-style experience for the person who knows they don't feel their best, wants to feel better, and is looking for a trusted guide rather than another one-off transaction: lab testing, continuous care, and access to treatment, wrapped into one experience that compounds over time.

This is a rare seat. We're a company known for physical product and transactional care, making the leap to a sticky, engagement-driven, relationship-driven digital experience. Few established companies reach that moment, and fewer put a single person at the center of it. You'll work across the entire company to define what it looks like, and you'll do it on top of the AI infrastructure we're building, as someone who works that way themselves.

You Will:

  • Own the end-to-end consumer experience for this new relationship-first offering, from discovery and onboarding through ongoing engagement

  • Define the synthesis layer across our existing categories, and stand up the new product lines the offering needs

  • Partner with engineering and design to build AI into the core of the consumer experience

  • Partner with our clinical teams so protocols, safety, and education are core to the product experience

  • Shape short- and long-term roadmaps, driving long-term scalability while balancing day-to-day improvements

  • Operate with focus in a fast-growing, constantly evolving environment, where there are always more opportunities than resources

You Have:

  • 6+ years of product management experience, working collaboratively across cross-functional teams

  • A track record of building and shipping consumer products that customers love and that drive meaningful business impact

  • A strong, specific point of view on where AI can meaningfully reshape the consumer healthcare experience, and the excitement to build it into the core of the product

  • Fluency with AI agents and AI-native workflows. AI-native is your default operating mode: you work with agents the way most PMs work with docs, fluently and constantly

  • Strategic and tactical range: you can set the vision and also design and execute scalable processes from scratch, ideally in an operations-intensive environment

  • Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you. This is a fully remote role, so clear written communication and proactive collaboration matter

  • Bonus: experience in health, wellness, or category-defining 0-to-1 products

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.

To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement.

Clover Health’s People Operations team is the strategic force behind our human capital management. We attract and recruit top talent and we’re proud of our data-driven approach to talent engagement and feel privileged to support our global workforce. We’re looking for an experienced Contract Technical Recruiter to join our high-performing Talent Acquisition team for a six-month engagement supporting our subsidiary, Counterpart Health, partnering with stakeholders across every team to understand business objectives, develop strategic hiring plans, and recruit amazing talent.

Our ideal candidate has experience recruiting for a variety of technical skill sets ideally in the HealthTech space and is eager to take on the challenge of our growing company and working with some of the best tools on the market. Most importantly, you are excited to experiment with new approaches to talent acquisition in order to build a best in class team at Clover Health.

As a Contract Technical Recruiter you will:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for a subset of Clover's technology teams. Partner with hiring managers to understand role scope and business needs in order to build out effective job descriptions, hiring/interview plans and targeted sourcing strategies.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Lovable
description_html:
TL;DR - Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.

You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

Who you are

  • A clear, sharp writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.

  • Strong at positioning: you can look at a user segment and a product moment and know what story will resonate.

  • Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling.

  • Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.

  • Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why.

  • Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles.

  • Experience at a high tech company.

  • Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to paid to expansion journey.

  • A track record of writing customer facing content, campaigns, or messaging that you can speak to in detail, and that you can point to measurable outcomes for.

  • Experience partnering with product, growth, or lifecycle teams to bring messaging into their workflows, without owning the underlying roadmap or systems.

    Preferred:

  • Experience working alongside lifecycle or CRM tools such as Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io, even if you weren't the one operating them.

  • Familiarity with growth metrics and experimentation frameworks (PQLs, activation rate, feature adoption) enough to speak the same language as a Growth PM.

  • Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences.

  • Experience building messaging frameworks or toolkits that scaled across multiple teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey, from signup through activation and expansion.

  • Partner with the Growth PM to translate their roadmap and experimentation priorities into strong, on-brand messaging, bringing your own point of view on framing and positioning rather than just executing briefs.

  • Work hand in hand with the Lifecycle team on new content and messaging for email, in-app surfaces, and push notifications, ensuring everything reflects our positioning and voice.

  • Develop clear point of view documents and messaging guidance for different self serve segments (solo founders, indie hackers, small teams) that inform both lifecycle content and broader growth campaigns.

  • Write and refine copy for high leverage touchpoints: onboarding flows, activation nudges, upgrade prompts, and in-app messaging.

  • Review and sharpen messaging coming out of experiments and campaigns, helping the team understand not just whether something worked, but why, from a messaging and positioning lens.

  • Build a shared messaging toolkit (voice, tone, positioning by segment, proof points) that Lifecycle and Growth can both draw from.

  • Represent the messaging and positioning perspective in growth planning, as a thought partner to the Growth PM rather than an owner of the roadmap itself.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: QA Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Foundation Health
description_html:
About Foundation Health

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role

You'd be joining alongside our QA Lead in the US, with real ownership of building this out properly in the UK: strategy, tooling, standards, process — all still very much taking shape. There's no hands-off management here — everybody, at every level, is hands-on, and that includes you.

And because we're AI-native by design, testing here isn't testing conventional software. You'll be leading the charge on how we test AI-led products across the UK — agentic workflows, LLM-based features, non-deterministic behaviour that doesn't fit a traditional pass/fail script.

What you'll actually do:

  • Build out our QA function properly: strategy, process, tooling and standards, working alongside our US QA Lead as we grow this on both sides of the Atlantic

  • Design and own testing for AI-driven features: agentic workflows, LLM outputs, evaluation frameworks, and the genuinely hard question of what "correct" even means when a system doesn't behave the same way twice

  • Get hands-on with automation using Playwright and TypeScript — and just as hands-on with manual testing, regression and UAT when that's what a release actually needs. This isn't a role where you delegate the manual work away

  • Set the bar for how quality gets handled company-wide as we scale — not just catching bugs, but building the culture that prevents them

  • Work closely with Engineering and Product to make sure quality is part of how things get built, not a gate bolted on at the end

Who thrives here?

  • Builders, not inheritors. You've either grown a QA function from something small before, or you've been desperate for the chance to. Coming into an established, fully-formed process isn't what excites you — shaping something still taking form is.

  • Genuinely fluent in AI, not just aware of it. AI is already part of your day-to-day — you use it properly, and you're curious about pushing it further. And on the testing side, you've either tested AI-led products already or you understand exactly why testing them is a different problem to testing normal software.

  • True hybrids, with zero ego about it. You're as comfortable writing a Playwright suite in TypeScript as you are doing hands-on manual testing, regression and UAT. Nobody here delegates the "unglamorous" work away — including you.

  • Strong technical fundamentals underneath the modern tooling. Test strategy, defect management, release process — the fundamentals are solid, even if the problems you're applying them to are new.

  • People who lead by doing. This role grows into shaping and leading QA in the UK as we scale. But there's no hands-off management track here — whoever's in this role is still testing, still in the detail, still building alongside the team, at every stage of growth.

title: Customer Success Engineer ( London)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Deepgram
description_html:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Our Customer Success team — The Heartbeat of Deepgram — sits at the intersection of customers, product, and growth. We don't just "manage accounts." We make Deepgram succeed inside our customers' environments by combining deep technical expertise, commercial instinct, and an AI-native way of working — and by building the systems that make the whole team's work compound over time.

 

A Customer Success Engineer is a hands-on partner who drives adoption, solves hard technical problems, uncovers expansion, and owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end to end.

Who You Are

You're not a traditional CSM or Technical Account Manager. You operate at the intersection of three competencies, and you're genuinely strong across all three:

 

  1. Expert technical consulting — you run demos, guide architecture discussions, troubleshoot integrations, and help customers deploy AI-driven solutions. No coding required, but you're fluent in APIs, developer workflows, and real technical conversations.

  2. Strategic account management — you build trust from individual developers up to CTOs, own the full customer lifecycle, and turn technical adoption into commercial growth.

  3. AI-native operating model — AI is how you work, not a tool you occasionally reach for. When you hit recurring work, your instinct is to build the system that removes it.

 

You may have been a Technical Account Manager, Solutions or Sales Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Implementation Engineer, strategic CSM, or Product Manager. Whatever your path, you're probably strongest in one or two of these competencies — but you can demonstrate all three, and you're eager for a role where you deploy them concurrently.

 

You thrive on bringing definition to ambiguity. You form a point of view and bring a recommendation rather than staying in open-ended discovery mode. You're comfortable operating outside your comfort zone, you question the status quo, and you learn fast.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the technical advisor and strategic owner for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, partnering with everyone from developers to CIOs and CTOs.

  • Own the full customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, technical enablement, expansion, and advocacy.

  • Drive adoption through live demos, workshops, architecture guidance, troubleshooting, and best-practice recommendations — making Deepgram successful inside the customer's environment.

  • Run discovery continuously: surface customer problems, understand their business impact, and translate them into actionable requirements for product and engineering.

  • Identify and scope expansion (cross-sell, upsell, multi-product) in partnership with Sales, and lead executive business reviews and joint planning sessions.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally — influencing roadmap, GTM strategy, and the tools we build to support customers.

  • Track adoption, usage, health, and expansion to drive outcomes; travel to customer sites as needed.

  • Operate AI-first by default, and build tools, agents, and workflows that eliminate recurring work for you and the broader CS team. Your impact is measured by the leverage you create, not just the accounts you serve.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience in technical, customer-facing roles — TAM, sales/solutions engineering, enterprise CS with a strong technical focus, implementation, or forward-deployed work — at API-driven, developer-first, or AI companies. For most people that's roughly 7+ years, but we care more about the shape of your experience than the exact number.

  • A track record that blends customer ownership with technical depth: solution design, hands-on troubleshooting, and commercial growth.

  • Hands-on experience running demos, POCs, or technical workshops with enterprise customers — leading them, not just attending.

  • Demonstrated success identifying and landing expansion in complex enterprise accounts.

  • Fluency discussing APIs, integrations, and developer workflows, and troubleshooting L1-style issues (no coding required, but genuinely conversant — not hand-waving).

  • Experience engaging both technical stakeholders (developers, architects) and executive buyers (CIO, CTO, VP Engineering).

  • Exceptional communication, influence, and relationship-building — concise and structured, across technical and business audiences.

  • Something you've built — a tool, agent, script, or workflow — that permanently eliminated recurring work. In your application, tell us what it was, what it replaced, and what it's still doing today.

  • An AI-native operating model: specific workflows that structurally depend on AI, and a clear account of how you'd rebuild them if those tools disappeared tomorrow.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in machine learning, voice AI, cloud infrastructure, or developer-first technologies.

  • A background spanning solutions engineering, TAM, or L1 support alongside CS responsibilities.

  • Working fluency with automation, scripting, or agent-building (Python, TypeScript, workflow tools, agent frameworks, or equivalent). You don't need to be a software engineer — just dangerous enough to ship working systems.

title: Full Stack Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Plinth
description_html:
TL;DR:

We’re looking for a full stack developer that wants to make a difference. Come join us to build a platform to radically improve service delivery and increase funding to the charity sector. We don’t have any hard cutoffs for years of experience, you’d be a great fit if you like building products but want a lot more freedom to do so with a large leeway to define your own role.

Reasons why this may be the job for you:

  • We’re aiming to build an engineering team with high a weight to power ratio. As a result, we aren’t going to be in meetings 7 hours a day, there is no daily scrum, you will not be writing design documents. Our goal is to produce quality software, and to get it into the hands of our users as soon as it’s ready. If you agree with this then we’d love for you to press apply.

  • If you’ve got a pretty broad exposure to technology and ideally a Computer Science degree (not a hard requirement). We’re looking for a capable generalist who can move between frontend/backend/dev ops but if you’ve not done it before you look at a task and say “I can figure this out easily”.

  • We’re laissez faire on whether you use AI tooling; if you want to hotspot cursor on the Avanti West Coast line back from Warrington in order to solve a clients issue, we 100% back you (It just better be good code).

  • We believe that years of experience is a poor metric for discovering quality. If, ideally, you’ve worked a job before, even more ideally you’ve shipped a product from start to end solo. This is the job for you if you want to ship, get it right first time.

⏳ Plinth:

💞 What we do

The charity sector is huge. In total income, it’s twice the size of the advertising, fashion and restaurant industries, combined. But it’s also extremely underserved by tech platforms to support the work they do.

That’s what we’re solving. An AI platform for all charities, particularly the smaller, local organisations. That saves them from millions of hours of bureaucracy, helps more people access their services, and supports them to get more funding.

🛠️ The product

We’re not a simple point solution. It’s a comprehensive platform, solving everything from safeguarding information, writing funding applications, taking bookings for venues/activities, giving grants and statutory reporting on Government contracts.

It becomes the system of record for the organisations we work with. On top of this record, we’re building tools to allow charities to deeply understand their impact (with mapping, visualisation and analysis) and to use this information to get more funding — through generating impact reports and funding applications with AI.

As a result of this, one day you could be working on changes to our grant management system for large grant makers or the next you could be figuring out how to improve the onboarding flow for small charities wanting to run events. It’s a broad product with plenty of room for you to define what you’d like to work on.

📈 Where we’re up to

We’re a team of 15 and growing fast. We have over 1,500 charities and 45 foundations using the platform, and we’re working with funders powering £55 million worth of charitable funding annually, which is growing 4x every year.

🪧 Our values

  • Charities come first. While they don’t pay us, they are the people we need to be focusing on: supporting them to work towards their own missions more effectively. Being trusted by them is the most important thing.

  • Childish enthusiasm is better than professional cynicism.

  • Open and transparent. Better to be appear dumb than pretend you understand.

  • Never the delay. Things move slowly in our sector, but we're not going to be responsible for it. We need to be unreasonably fast.

  • Driven by the mission. We're going to work hard, because getting this right could be massive.

  • There are no ninjas, there is no door. We need to figure out how to solve the tricky problems ourselves, because no one else is going to.

📋 The role

  • Writing front-end and back-end code in Typescript.

  • Shaping the architecture for new and existing features.

  • Building tools to support onboarding new customers, as we help more and more people migrate off existing systems.

  • Fixing bugs, and supporting the customer success team to handle user issues.

🤳 What we’re looking for

  • Someone who can build reusable infrastructure with sensible interfaces that’s easy for team members (both human and AI) to build on top of.

  • Willing to take on complex features from the initial idea to maintaining them in production.

  • Multiple years experience shipping code and managing complex systems.

  • Familiarity with React, ideally some experience of Elasticsearch.

  • All of the standard stuff: Git, agile, testing, etc etc

  • Ideally, some experience with the charity sector, either in employment, or as a volunteer/trustee.

💸 Logistics

  • Location: London (we work regularly from our Old Street office)

  • Salary: £90-110k, with meaningful equity

title: Customer Success Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mast
description_html:
Mast is on a mission to make complex lending simple. The UK's specialist lending market is underserved by technology, with legacy systems that can't handle the nuance of complex income, niche products, or the broker workflows that specialist lenders rely on.

We're building modern, cloud-native lending technology, purpose-built for specialist lenders, that helps them process more applications in less time, reach decisions faster, and deliver better experiences for brokers and borrowers.

We're pioneering the use of AI in mortgage origination, building it into the platform from the ground up rather than bolting it onto legacy architecture.. We work with regulated lenders across the UK, have a 100% delivery track record, and are building a high-performance team where everyone has real ownership and direct impact.

About the role

This is not a traditional support role, and you do not need any previous customer support or technology experience to apply.

This role is ideal for a recent graduate or someone early in their career who wants to get into tech. What matters most is your attitude: we are looking for someone curious, reliable, organised, eager to learn, and willing to get stuck in..

You will help lenders, brokers, and internal teams get the best out of Mast. You will answer questions, investigate issues, improve support processes, create documentation, spot recurring product friction, and turn customer conversations into ideas that shape the platform.

You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, and Implementation. Over time, this role has the potential to grow into leading Mast's customer support function as the company scales.

What you'll do

Support customers and users

Triage, investigate, and manage support requests from start to finish, escalating to Product or Engineering where needed while keeping people informed.

You will build deep knowledge of Mast's platform, including mortgage journeys, forms, policy prompts, automations, integrations, product configuration, and broker/lender workflows.

Build the support operating system

Help design how support works at Mast: ticketing workflows, escalation routes, response templates, internal runbooks, help centre content, and reporting dashboards.

You will look for repetitive questions and manual processes, then automate them through better tooling, documentation, AI-assisted workflows, or process changes.

Turn support into product insight

Because this role reports into Product, you will do more than answer questions.

You will identify patterns in customer feedback, recurring pain points, confusing workflows, and missing features, then translate those into product ideas, bug reports, and roadmap input.

Create self-service documentation

Write clear, practical help articles, FAQs, release notes, troubleshooting guides, onboarding material, and internal playbooks.

You will help keep everything up to date as the platform evolves.

Use AI to work smarter

Use AI tools to draft documentation, summarise issues, identify patterns, write clearer responses, and speed up repetitive work.

You don't need to be an AI expert. We are looking for someone curious, experimental, and willing to learn.

What we're looking for

We are not looking for years of experience. We are looking for potential.

You may be a recent graduate or early in your career. You do not need previous customer support, fintech, mortgage, or software experience.

The most important things are that you:

  • Have a great attitude and want to learn quickly

  • Are reliable, thoughtful, and willing to take ownership

  • Can work independently, spot what needs doing, and make progress without needing detailed instructions every time

  • Communicate clearly and calmly in writing

  • Are organised and detail-oriented, especially when managing several issues or follow-ups at once

  • Are comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

  • Enjoy solving problems and making things easier for others

  • Are curious about technology, software, and AI

  • Are comfortable working remotely and managing your own time

  • Naturally ask, “How can this be easier next time?”

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, Linear, Jira, Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot, Loom, Metabase, or AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude

  • Experience from university projects, internships, part-time work, customer-facing roles, or startup environments

  • Interest in product management, customer success, operations, automation, or fintech

  • Experience writing clear documentation, guides, or process notes

What success looks like

First 3 months: Strong understanding of Mast's platform and customer workflows. Ownership of incoming support requests. Clearer processes for tracking and resolving issues.

6 to 12 months: Reduced repeat questions through better documentation and automation. A reliable feedback loop into Product. Clear visibility into where customers struggle and where the product can improve.

Longer term: You help define what excellent customer support looks like at Mast, and may grow into leading the support function.

Salary & Location

Location: London or UK Remote

Salary: £30,000 to £35,000 + Stock Options

Target Start date : Immediate

Benefits

  • Stock Option Plan

  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays

  • 4 - 10 weeks work from anywhere, based on tenure (for UK based roles)

  • Vitality Health insurance

  • Pension plan

  • Equipment budget

  • Learning & development budget

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

  • Monthly team socials + Quarterly Team Meet-ups @ HQ

  • Digital-first, employee-first company with a flexible working culture + Central London HQ

About Us

Mast is a high-performance team of engineers and lending experts building the future of specialist lending technology. We value radical honesty, transparency, and speed. We hire exceptional people, expect a lot from each other, and offer real ownership, fast growth, and the chance to shape an industry.

Mast. is an equal opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Our Performance Marketing team is growing, and we’re looking for a Creative Strategist to join us in London.

This is a performance role for someone who lives at the intersection of creative, culture and data. You’ll work across all of ur markets and verticals, turning audience insight, platform trends and performance data into creative that drives measurable growth.

You’ll have real ownership. We want someone who can help us build a best-in-class creative testing engine: finding the insight, developing the hypothesis, shaping the concept, getting it produced, analysing what happened and making the next test better.

We’re not looking for someone to make ads prettier. We’re looking for someone obsessed with understanding why people stop, click and convert and who wants to test those ideas at speed.

You’ll work closely with our Performance Marketing and Creative teams, as well as creators and external partners. You’ll also be hands-on: comfortable briefing polished production when it matters, but equally happy picking up a phone or opening CapCut and getting a lo-fi prototype live when speed matters more.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own creative experimentation - build and run the creative testing roadmap across Meta, TikTok, Snap and emerging channels, taking ideas from hypothesis → brief → production → analysis → learning.

  • Obsess over the customer - mine reviews, Reddit, competitor activity, customer research and performance data to understand the problems, motivations and objections behind the click.

  • Turn insight into ideas - develop personas, hooks, angles and concepts across different stages of customer awareness, rather than endlessly iterating the same offer-led creative.

  • Build our UGC and lo-fi engine - source and brief creators, shoot or prototype content yourself, edit when required and help us dramatically increase the diversity and velocity of what we test.

  • Live in the platforms - understand what feels native to Meta, TikTok and Snap, monitor trends and competitors continuously, and turn relevant opportunities into testable concepts quickly.

  • Turn data back into creative - use metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, CAC and win rate to understand why something worked, not simply whether it did.

  • Make our learning compound - maintain a clear testing and insights system, run creative retros and make sure successful patterns travel across channels, geographies and verticals.

  • Use AI aggressively and intelligently - apply generative AI, creative intelligence and production tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping and iteration without replacing the thinking behind the work.

  • Raise the creative capability of the whole team - bring outside thinking into Quantum, coach marketers on stronger creative briefs and work as the bridge between Performance Marketing and Creative.


About You

  • You’ve spent 2+ years in creative strategy, performance creative, paid social or a closely related growth role, ideally within DTC, affiliate, agency or another performance-led environment.

  • You understand paid social commercially. You know the difference between content that gets attention and creative that ultimately acquires customers profitably.

  • You’re hands-on with UGC and lo-fi production. You can find creators, write scripts, brief effectively and use tools such as CapCut, Canva or similar to get an idea into market yourself.

  • You’re genuinely plugged into social platforms, culture and creative trends. You notice formats, hooks and behaviours before somebody sends you a deck about them.

  • You’re analytically curious. You’re comfortable interrogating performance data and translating it into the next creative hypothesis.

  • You have strong creative and messaging instincts - able to take messy customer insight and distil it into one simple, compelling idea.

  • You naturally experiment. You’d rather test a good hypothesis this week than debate the perfect answer for a month.

  • You’re excited by AI and emerging creative technology and are constantly looking for ways to make yourself and the people around you faster and better.

  • Experience in iGaming, finance, subscription or another regulated/performance-led vertical is useful, but not essential.

  • And finally, no ego. We want someone curious, ambitious and collaborative who gets excited by finding out they were wrong almost as much as finding a winner.

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

If you join us, you’ll be helping to improve the property industry for everyone by widening the reach of our products and introducing them to Estate Agents across the UK; in turn making agents more successful and helping them deliver an incredible customer experience. We'll support you with structured training, a competitive commission structure, and an open and inclusive environment.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!

A bit about you…

  • You'll have previous outbound sales experience in a B2B setting

  • You’ll have experience delivering on set monthly KPI’s/targets.

  • You’re self motivated, with a proactive attitude towards working to targets, with a tenacious nature and a strong desire to succeed.

  • You’re a self-starter who can take initiative when needed and isn’t afraid to pick up the phone and make contact with potential new clients.

  • You’re curious and conscientious, you’ll make it your business to know everything about our product and have the communication skills to share that knowledge in a way that inspires.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. If you are resilient, hard-working, and want to earn a ton of money - we'd love to see your application!

Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Sales Development Representative at Street Group

  • Supporting the wider Sales, Customer Success and Marketing teams to identify and engage new business opportunities.

  • Connecting with prospective customers through conducting engaging outbound calls, crafting compelling emails and connecting with them on other platforms.

  • Immersing yourself in the company and sharing your informed passion for our evolving product.

  • Identifying, building and nurturing a pipeline of self-generated client prospects.

  • Working collaboratively with your team and the wider group to ensure high performance. Collaboration is what we do best!

  • Ensuring our customers have a first-class experience at every opportunity.

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Spectre is now our multi award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%. Street.co.uk then launched back in 2020 and serves as our game-changing CRM, allowing agents to deliver a service that aligns seamlessly with the modern, 'on-demand' needs of customers and their busy lifestyles.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Why join Street Group?

🏠Competitive salary + uncapped commission
💃 Paid quarterly team nights out
💸 Weekly + monthly incentives
🍽️ Top performers dinners
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

2 stages = Introductory phone call with one of our Talent team > Hiring Manager interview including a short outbound call roleplay.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made, or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know!


A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.


How we use AI in the hiring process
Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers on interviews so that they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions!

description_html:
Product Manager – Compliance

Help Shape the Future of AI Compliance in Financial Services

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers, and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. Recognized as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025, we are backed by leading investors and supported by major financial institutions as we scale rapidly amid accelerating AI adoption in financial services.

 

Our platform enables some of the UK’s largest financial institutions to deploy AI safely in FCA-regulated environments, powering everything from compliance monitoring to AI-driven adviser guidance.

 

We are seeking a Product Manager – Assurance to play a central role in Aveni’s Assurance portfolio: products that help financial services firms govern, test, and assure AI agents and human interactions across the customer journey.

 

The Role

This role is primarily focused on Agent Approve, Aveni’s pre-deployment simulation and testing product, with additional responsibility for Detect, our post-interaction compliance assessment product.

 

Agent Approve is a growth-stage product operating in a dynamic regulatory environment. You will own the product from discovery through commercial readiness, helping define Aveni’s position in an emerging market.

 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership product role. You will collaborate closely with the Head of Assurance Products on strategy and roadmap direction while independently driving discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and go-to-market readiness. You will work with engineering, design, customer success, marketing, and commercial teams to turn complex customer and regulatory problems into clear, valuable, and shippable product outcomes.

 

You are well suited to this role if you enjoy operating in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex problem spaces, and possess the judgement to prioritize effectively, distinguishing what matters, what can wait, and what needs validation before building.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the Agent Approve and Detect product roadmaps from problem discovery and opportunity sizing through prioritisation, delivery, and launch readiness.

  • Lead continuous discovery with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders, developing an evidence-based view of market direction and urgent problem areas.

  • Translate ideas and customer problems into low- and high-fidelity prototypes to validate assumptions early, reduce delivery risk, and accelerate decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and design to convert strategy into executable delivery plans, maintain a prioritized backlog, and support squads through delivery.

  • Build strong relationships across engineering, commercial, customer success, and marketing, serving as a trusted voice on what we are building, why it matters, and how it supports Aveni's Assurance portfolio.

  • Stay current with industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitor activity in financial services compliance, QA technology, and AI assurance, ensuring product decisions are grounded in market context.

  • Use data and metrics to inform prioritization, define product KPIs, and measure the success of features and capabilities.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally owning a roadmap from discovery to delivery.

  • Domain expertise in financial services, compliance, risk, or regulatory technology, and experience leading stakeholder discovery and translating insights into product strategy.

  • Strong product judgement, clear communication skills, and confidence in shaping problem spaces, defining direction, defending prioritization decisions, and explaining trade-offs to diverse audiences.

  • Analytical rigor, comfort using data to guide decisions, and ability to build trusted relationships with engineers, designers, and senior commercial stakeholders.

  • Self-directed, proactive individuals comfortable in early-stage or ambiguous product environments where the path is not fully defined.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-powered products, analytics, or model-driven tooling; familiarity with FCA regulatory frameworks, Consumer Duty, or conduct risk.

  • Exposure to pre-deployment testing, quality assurance, or compliance workflows.

  • Experience writing compelling product narratives for commercial or go-to-market purposes, especially relevant for the growth-stage nature of Agent Approve.

 

Why Join Aveni?

You will work on complex and meaningful challenges at the intersection of AI, regulation, and financial services. You will help shape a product category that is growing in importance as financial institutions move from experimenting with AI to deploying it safely, responsibly, and at scale. You will have real ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to influence both product direction and market positioning during a pivotal stage of Aveni’s growth.

 

Benefits at Aveni

  • Remote-first working across the UK

  • Company-wide offsites and regular in-person gatherings

  • Work abroad policy

  • Optional Personal Development Plan

  • Flexible benefits platform for selecting the benefits that matter most to you

  • Life insurance, income protection, critical illness cover, and pension with up to 5% matched employer contribution

  • Private health and dental care

 

Join Us

At Aveni, we believe diversity drives innovation. We strive for an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work.

 

If you are passionate about technology and its role in shaping the future of financial services, we encourage you to apply—even if you do not meet every requirement. We would love to hear from you if you believe you could be a great fit.

description_html:
About the job

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. We've been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors and commercially supported by major financial institutions, we're scaling quickly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates.

 

Our Wealth platform helps financial advice firms transform how advisers and paraplanners work, using AI to automate documentation, improve compliance and streamline client servicing. From meeting summaries and document generation to compliance file checking and workflow automation, we're helping firms deliver a better experience for both advisers and their clients.

We're looking for a Product Manager – Wealth to lead the evolution of Aveni Assist, our flagship AI-powered platform for financial advice firms.

 

The role

 

This role is responsible for the strategy, roadmap and delivery of Aveni Assist, driving its continued evolution across core adviser workflows including meeting summaries, document generation, Letters of Authority, fact finds and compliance file checking.

 

Unlike an early-stage product, Aveni Assist already has an established customer base and a strong market presence. Your focus will be on scaling the product through continuous improvement—enhancing customer workflows, increasing adoption and satisfaction, and delivering measurable value that drives retention and growth.

 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership product role. You'll work closely with the Head of Product (Wealth) on product strategy while independently leading customer discovery, roadmap prioritisation, delivery and release planning. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Design, Customer Success and Commercial teams to ensure we're solving the right problems and delivering the highest-value outcomes.

 

We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding complex customer needs, making evidence-based decisions and building products that customers genuinely value.

 

What you'll be doing

 

  • You'll own the Aveni Assist roadmap end-to-end, balancing investment between new capabilities, product quality and platform improvements to maximise customer and commercial impact.

  • You'll lead continuous discovery with advisers, paraplanners, compliance teams and prospects, building a deep understanding of customer workflows and translating insight into product decisions.

  • You'll rapidly validate ideas using prototypes, customer research and experimentation, reducing delivery risk before committing engineering effort.

  • You'll own beta programmes for new capabilities, working closely with customers to gather structured feedback and determine when features are ready for general release.

  • You'll partner closely with Engineering and Design to translate strategy into clear delivery plans, maintaining a healthy backlog and ensuring features are released with a high standard of quality.

  • You'll build strong relationships across Engineering, Customer Success, Commercial and Marketing, acting as a trusted voice for the product and ensuring customer insight informs decision-making across the business.

  • You'll use customer feedback, usage analytics and product metrics to guide prioritisation, measure success and continually improve the product.

  • You'll stay informed about industry trends, adviser technology, AI developments and FCA regulation, ensuring Aveni Assist continues to lead the market.

 

What we're looking for

 

  • We're looking for someone with a proven track record as a Product Manager in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with experience scaling an established product by improving customer satisfaction, adoption and retention.

  • You'll have demonstrable experience leading customer discovery, translating customer insight into product decisions and working closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality software.

  • You'll have excellent product judgement, strong communication skills and the confidence to make difficult prioritisation decisions, balancing customer needs with commercial objectives.

  • You'll be analytically rigorous, comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, and capable of building trusted relationships across technical and commercial teams.

  • We're particularly interested in people who are proactive, self-directed and passionate about improving products through continuous iteration and customer feedback.

 

Nice to have

 

  • Experience with AI-powered products or machine learning technologies would be valuable, as would experience within financial services, wealth management or other regulated industries.

  • Knowledge of FCA Consumer Duty, adviser technology platforms or wealth management workflows would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

  • Experience running beta programmes, defining quality standards for AI-generated outputs or contributing to go-to-market activities would also be beneficial.

 

Why join Aveni?

 

You’ll work on genuinely difficult and meaningful problems at the intersection of AI, regulation and financial services.

 

You’ll help shape a product category that is becoming increasingly important as financial institutions move from experimenting with AI to deploying it safely, responsibly and at scale.

 

You’ll have real ownership, visibility and the opportunity to influence both product direction and market positioning at an important stage of Aveni’s growth.

 

Benefits at Aveni

 

What you’ll love:

  • Remote-first working across the UK

  • Company-wide offsites and regular in-person gatherings

  • Work abroad policy

  • Optional Personal Development Plan

  • Flexible benefits platform, so you can choose the benefits that matter most to you

  • Life insurance, income protection, critical illness cover and pension, with up to 5% matched employer contribution

  • Private health and dental care

 

At Aveni, we believe diversity drives innovation. We’ve built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work.

If you’re passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we’d love to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we’d still encourage you to apply if you believe you’d be a great fit.
