title: Head of Sales EMEA, Public Sector
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Cohere
description_html:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

As our Head of Sales EMEA Public Sector you will spearhead year-over-year revenue growth by developing and executing on enterprise level PUBSEC customer acquisition strategies across the region. You will drive long-term success through strategic development, coaching, and expanding Cohere’s presence in EMEA public sector, anchored in Defense. In this pivotal leadership role, you will cultivate and guide our EMEA PUBSEC sales team to exceed revenue targets and organizational goals, while fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

Candidates must be based in Germany to be considered for this career opportunity.

As our Head of EMEA PUBSEC you will:

  • Develop, execute, and lead a comprehensive go-to-market growth strategy and sales plan for EMEA PUBSEC, driving revenue growth and market expansion working with the North American Public Sector and other regional sales teams.

  • Provide sales and operational leadership to Cohere’s EMEA PUBSEC sales team, ensuring alignment with company objectives and priorities.

  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to synchronize sales efforts with broader company goals.

  • Represent Cohere at EMEA PUBSEC industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities, as well as with regulators and government agencies, in collaboration with other regional and global leaders in Cohere.

  • Manage and nurture relationships with government decision-makers and partners to ensure Cohere’s success in the region. Identify and pursue new business opportunities, negotiating and closing high-value deals.

  • Collaborate with global teams to strengthen anchor relationships and establish best practices for enterprise-level project implementations, ensuring strong client engagement throughout project lifecycles.

This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you:

  • Have 10+ years of PUBSEC sales and leadership experience leading go-to-market efforts and driving revenue growth for fast paced technology organizations.

  • Have an established network in Germany and EMEA region, including federal agencies, prime contractors, and industry associations.

  • Possess a proven track record of leading capture and sales efforts for consultative solution sales and business development efforts, with a deep understanding of regional procurement and budget cycles, customer success, and resource allocation.

  • Have exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to build cross-functional relationships and influence at all levels.

  • Are comfortable operating in a matrix environment, coordinating efforts across cross-functional teams and regions without the need for a large direct organization.

  • Are a self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, capable of working independently, rolling up sleeves, and driving impact as a ‘builder.’

  • Experience in AI or a related industry is highly desirable.

  • English and German language skills are essential.

  • Must be based in Germany with willingness to travel (25-35%).

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

description_html:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

title: Senior Communications Specialist (Global Communications)

description_html:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Help shape how one of Europe's most ambitious deep-tech companies is understood by the world.

  • As a member of the Communications team, you will lead the execution of our global communications workstream, translating company priorities into high-impact media engagement, executive positioning and integrated campaigns—ensuring the right stories reach the right audiences at the right time.

  • Use communications to help secure financing, build trust, shape public debate and make one of the world's most ambitious engineering projects visible long before its impact becomes obvious.

  • working closely with colleagues across Communications and Brand & Content to deliver integrated communications programs.

Must-haves

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Proxima Fusion GmbH
description_html:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, analysis, validation and realisation of Proxima’s Alpha stellarator fusion machine. Your innovative and detailed engineering work will deliver robust mechanical, structural, and thermal performance of critical systems, tooling and manufacturing processes. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Develop innovative solutions and detailed mechanical designs for significant systems within the Alpha stellarator, ensuring integration with the broader physics, mechanical and structural systems.

  • Carry out thermal and structural analysis and assessment of mechanical designs, providing design input and implementing recommended design improvements.

  • Conduct technology trade-offs, materials selections and feasibility studies to facilitate the successful identification of the Alpha net energy stellarator.

  • Design, deliver, and support the prototyping and verification of the components, materials, assemblies and manufacturing processes selected for Alpha.

  • Work with external suppliers and collaborators to assist and guide the development and manufacture of the components and systems that will come together to demonstrate the net energy Alpha stellarator.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • High performers with excellent communication and problem-solving skills who love challenges and are not afraid to experiment, take risks, and learn from mistakes.

  • Experience in designing and analysing mechanical components and assemblies, with proficiency in CAD (experience with 3DExperience/CATIA v6 and ANSYS is highly beneficial, but not essential).

  • Experience in designing and delivering the conceptual and detailed design of mechanical, structural, thermal or electro-mechanical equipment, particularly for use in research, development, prototyping and manufacturing.

  • Knowledge and experience of designing and selecting materials for some or all of the following engineering applications: high temperature, cryogenic, electromagnetic, vacuum.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with and manage external suppliers, with multidisciplinary technical teams in fast-paced, dynamic settings.

  • Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential.

  • Recruiter Interview (30-45 min)

  • Portfolio Presentation & Review (45-60 min)

  • Technical Panel Interviews (2x60 min)

title: Remote Engineering Manager (Algorithms Team) (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Roompricegenie
description_html:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As an Engineering Manager for the Algorithms team (Revenue Management Engine) at RoomPriceGenie, you will build and lead the team behind the core of our product: the pricing and forecasting engine that automatically prices rooms for thousands of hotels. This is the algorithmic and data heart of RoomPriceGenie, spanning the pricing algorithm, the forecasting models and the data pipelines that feed them.

This is a leadership role. Your focus is the team: delivery, people and the connection to product goals. You stay technically credible and close to the work through design and code review, and you get hands-on when the team needs it, but you are not coding day to day. You balance delivery speed with long-term technical health and build an environment of trust and accountability. The role also reaches beyond your own team: we want you leading the way on technical improvements at the Product and Engineering department level, things like engineering processes and operational excellence, as a hands-on driver.

You will work closely with a Product Manager and report to the Senior Engineering Manager. A core part of the job is turning a complex, data-heavy domain into reliable, measurable outcomes: shipping model and pipeline improvements, proving their impact through backtesting and clear quality metrics, and keeping pricing runs dependable at scale. We expect you to be a genuine partner to Product, able to challenge and shape what gets built, not only how.

Who you'll lead

You will lead a team of 4 engineers (3 Senior and 1 Staff). The role may also grow to include an Associate Engineering Manager over time.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing team across the pricing algorithm, forecasting and data pipelines, owning delivery, quality and the operational health of pricing runs.

  • Grow your people through regular 1:1s, feedback, performance reviews and career development.

  • Hire, onboard and develop engineers to keep the team balanced and strong.

  • Partner closely with Product and challenge them: push back on direction, bring your own point of view and drive changes to what the team builds, not just how it builds.

  • Translate business goals into clear engineering plans with measurable outcomes and realistic timelines. Use data (backtesting, model quality, before and after signals) to guide prioritisation.

  • Balance delivery velocity with technical sustainability, addressing debt, scalability and reliability as part of delivery rather than after it.

  • Provide technical oversight through design and code review, staying close enough to guide architecture and quality and to get hands-on when the team genuinely needs it.

  • Act as a buffer between the team and external pressure, keeping focus and healthy team dynamics.

  • Improve engineering processes and practices to increase clarity, alignment and predictable delivery.

  • Lead technical improvements beyond your own team, at the Product and Engineering department level, for example engineering processes and operational excellence. We want you hands-on and driving these, not only sponsoring them.

Your Profile

  • Strong software engineering background with a track record of building and operating production systems, ideally with depth in backend and data-intensive or algorithmic domains.

  • At least 5 years of experience, with several years genuinely managing engineers, including performance management. This is a role for an experienced manager, not a first step into leadership.

  • Experience growing or managing other managers, for example an Associate Engineering Manager or Team Leads, is a plus.

  • A strong product mindset with the confidence to challenge Product. You enjoy defining problems and validating solutions with PMs and you are comfortable disagreeing, proposing alternatives and driving them to a decision.

  • Technically credible and willing to get hands-on when the team needs it, while spending most of your time leading rather than in the code day to day.

  • Comfortable with our stack: Python/Django on the backend, with a data stack around Snowflake, dbt and Dagster. Exposure to forecasting, modelling or data engineering is a strong plus.

  • Strong grasp of system design, architecture and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication and leadership: you create clarity, trust and accountability, with a servant-leadership mindset toward your team.

  • You look beyond your own team and enjoy driving technical improvements that raise the bar across the wider Product and Engineering org.

  • Fluent in English and based in a European time zone (UTC+0 to UTC+2).

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

We kindly ask that recruitment agencies refrain from reaching out regarding this vacancy. Thank you for your understanding.

Compensation: €100K – €110K

description_html:
Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

title: .NET Software Developer (m/w/d) – AI-gestützte Produktentwicklung
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at QualityHosting GmbH
description_html:
Über Uns

Seit unserer Gründung 1998 ist die QualityHosting auf Microsoft-Technologien für geschäftskritische IT-Anwendungen spezialisiert. Wir sind Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) und Deutschlands Marktführer für Hosted Exchange. Unser Unternehmen bietet ein erweitertes Cloud-Portfolio inklusive Microsoft 365, Copilot & AI sowie leistungsfähige CloudServer für Unternehmen jeder Größe an.

Für unser Entwicklungsteam in Frankfurt am Main und Gelnhausen suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen erfahrenen .NET Software Developer (m/w/d) für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Plattform.

Du entwickelst in C#/.NET unser Kundencenter und die Automatisierung dahinter – damit Kunden ihre Microsoft-Cloud-Services selbst buchen und verwalten können, statt dafür ein Support-Ticket zu benötigen. Claude Code gehört dabei zu deinem normalen Entwicklungsalltag: Du nutzt AI-Agenten für die Umsetzung von Features, prüfst deren Ergebnisse kritisch und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns das Wissen und die Arbeitsweise weiter, auf die unsere Agents zugreifen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt klar auf der Softwareentwicklung – du setzt Features und technische Verbesserungen eigenständig um und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Qualität deiner Lösungen.

Über unser Kundencenter beziehen und verwalten Kunden und Partner ihre Microsoft-Cloud-Services im Self-Service. Dazu gehören unter anderem:

  • unser Cloud-Marketplace zum Buchen und Verwalten von Abonnements

  • Verwaltungsportale für Endkunden und Reseller

  • Managed Security 365 zum laufenden Schutz von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen

  • Backend-Prozesse zur automatisierten Bereitstellung und Abrechnung von Microsoft-365-, CSP- und Azure-Diensten

Technisch arbeiten wir überwiegend mit aktuellem .NET, C#, Blazor, Minimal APIs und Microsoft Azure.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen in unserem Cloud-Marketplace und den Verwaltungsportalen – von der Buchungsstrecke bis zur Subscription-Verwaltung für Endkunden und Reseller.

  • Du entwickelst und pflegst unsere Provisionierungsprozesse – von Sync- und Batch-Jobs bis zu Workern, die Microsoft 365, Azure und Hosted Exchange automatisiert bereitstellen, ändern und in die Abrechnung überführen.

  • Du integrierst externe Systeme über REST-APIs, beispielsweise Microsoft Graph, Partner Center/CSP, Hornetsecurity und Business Central – inklusive Authentifizierung, Webhooks sowie robustem Fehler- und Retry-Verhalten.

  • Du setzt Features eigenständig mit Claude Code und AI-Agenten um: Du bereitest den notwendigen Kontext vor, lässt Agents Teile der Umsetzung übernehmen und prüfst deren Ergebnisse kritisch.

  • Du entwickelst unser Projektwissen in CLAUDE.md und Claude Skills mit weiter, damit Erkenntnisse für das gesamte Team und unsere Agents nutzbar werden.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Jobs- und Queue-Plattform auf Basis von Azure Service Bus und Docker/ACR weiter, damit auch größere Verarbeitungsläufe zuverlässig funktionieren und Fehler nachvollziehbar bleiben.

  • Du erhöhst gezielt die Testabdeckung dort, wo Fehler besonders kritisch sind – beispielsweise bei Provisionierung, Lizenzzuweisung und Abrechnung – und verifizierst deine Änderungen, bevor sie produktiv gehen.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die technische Qualität deiner Umsetzung und hinterfragst AI-generierten Code genauso kritisch wie selbst geschriebenen Code.



Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# und .NET, insbesondere in der Web- und Backend-Entwicklung und idealerweise an produktiv betriebenen Systemen mit anspruchsvoller Fachlogik.

  • Erfahrung mit modernen .NET-Anwendungen. Wir arbeiten überwiegend mit .NET 8 oder neuer; einzelne Bestandsdienste laufen weiterhin auf .NET Framework 4.8.

  • Praktische Erfahrung damit, Features mit AI-Coding-Tools oder AI-Agenten umzusetzen, die deutlich über Autocomplete oder einzelne Code-Vorschläge hinausgeht.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits intensiv mit Claude Code gearbeitet. Entscheidend ist für uns aber vor allem, dass du weißt, wie Aufgaben für Coding Agents vorbereitet, umgesetzt und anschließend verifiziert werden.

  • Du möchtest generierten Code verstehen, bevor er produktiv geht: Du liest ihn kritisch gegen, sicherst wichtige Funktionen mit Tests ab und übernimmst Verantwortung für das Ergebnis.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit T-SQL, ein gutes Verständnis für Datenmodelle sowie praktische Erfahrung mit einem ORM wie NHibernate oder Entity Framework.

  • Erfahrung bei der Integration von REST-APIs, einschließlich Authentifizierung und Webhooks. Themen wie Retries, Timeouts und Idempotenz gehören für dich zu einer robusten Integration dazu.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Nice-To-Have

  • Erfahrung mit mandantenfähigen SaaS- und Self-Service-Anwendungen sowie Subscription- und Abrechnungsmodellen

  • Erfahrung mit cloud-nativer Entwicklung auf Microsoft Azure, beispielsweise mit Service Bus, Functions, Key Vault, Managed Identity, App Insights/OpenTelemetry oder Docker

  • Erfahrung mit Worker- und Queue-basierten Architekturen sowie resilienten Hintergrundprozessen

  • Microsoft-Cloud-Domänenwissen rund um CSP/Partner Center, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, GDAP, NCE, PowerShell oder Exchange

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD, GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps

  • Claude Skills, MCP-Server oder andere Automatisierungen rund um AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Appliedai
description_html:
About us

The appliedAI Initiative elevates Europe’s industry to become shapers in the age of AI, creating a future that we desire to live in. Through our ecosystem of strong partners, comprehensive programs, services and solutions we advance companies holistically on their AI journey. With our uniquely diverse, interdisciplinary, and driven team, we build on deep technical expertise while specializing on applicability of the solutions. We share a mindset of collaboration and openness with our ecosystem of leading companies and tech players. Our common goal is to strengthen the European landscape, jointly creating unique knowledge for applying trustworthy AI. We believe that AI Agents will be the dominant topic for AI in the near future and that appliedAI with its partner ecosystem will impact how this technology is being used in industry and beyond in Europe.


Your mission

Most of what makes an AI solution survive contact with a large enterprise is not the AI. It is the engineering discipline around it, and that discipline is what you bring. You do not need to arrive as an AI expert - you arrive as someone who knows how professional software gets built, shipped, and kept alive, and you grow into the agentic side alongside a team that is already deep in it. In our Engineering team you set the bar for what production-ready means here.
Your tasks will include:

  • Designing the technical approach for a system slice, from build and test through deployment and operation, including the documentation and artefacts a third party needs to run it without us
  • Shaping how we develop: issue workflows, branching and review standards, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security checks, and release management
  • Building the classical software around the AI core - services and APIs, data pipelines, infrastructure as code, mostly in Python on Azure 
  • Making solutions operable in enterprise IT landscapes: observability, failure behaviour, security posture, and cost transparency
  • Providing specialist guidance that shapes technical decisions across workstreams, and raising the engineering bar through design and code reviews
  • Making technical trade-offs legible to senior client stakeholders - what a given architecture or operating model costs and enables


Your profile

  • 8+ years building software that went into production and stayed there, ideally shaped by a product organisation with real release discipline
  • Deep working knowledge of the professional software development lifecycle: issue tracking and workflows (e.g. Jira), code review and development standards, CI/CD, automated testing, security scanning, versioning and releases
  • Strong Python, confidence on Azure, and hands-on experience with containers and infrastructure as code
  • Experience handing a system over to a separate operating team, or having operated one yourself long enough to know what that handover really demands
  • Some exposure to GenAI or agentic systems and genuine curiosity to go deeper; deep AI expertise is explicitly not a prerequisite
  • Composure in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders in English; German is a plus


What we offer

  • A highly qualified and motivated team of ~90 people is on a journey to change the rapidly evolving European AI Landscape
  • Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model: You can choose to work from our vibrant offices - either at the IPAI in Heilbronn or the House of Communication in Munich - while also enjoying the flexibility to work remotely a few days each week
  • Opportunity to shape a variety of projects and the development of new, original content based on the latest developments in AI and its adoption in businesses
  • An atmosphere that encourages to think and experiment in new ways with software, hardware, and processes
  • A highly visible initiative that helps you build a large and high-level network of start-ups, partners, and tech companies
  • A flexible development budget that’s yours to shape - invest it in training, certifications, conferences, or new challenges, however you want to grow
  • Sports membership with Wellpass to access thousands of sports facilities all over Germany (and beyond), as well as online courses
  • JobRad: Lease a bike for a cheaper rate via JobRad and we cover the bike insurance on top
  • Sabbatical option: You can take a sabbatical of up to 3 months after min. 3 years of employment - because sometimes 30 vacation days are not enough to explore the beauty of this world
  • PME Familienservice: A 24/7 support for a successful work & life in any life situation. Benefit from free support in areas like life coaching, child care and many other options
  • Mobility budget: Every month we contribute to your individual mobility usage with public transport or shared mobility offers within the app Moovster
  • Workation: Work from anywhere in the EU/EWR area for up to 3 months per year - combining working at a nice place and spending your leisure time in the evening like vacation


Contact

Lucas Fernandes - Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
appliedAI Initiative GmbH, August-Everding-Str. 25, 81671 München

Your mission

Most AI projects don't fail on the model - they fail because nobody wants to use what was built. As our Principal UX Designer, you'll be the specialist authority who makes sure that never happens for our clients: the person our AI Engineers, AI Consultants, and client teams turn to when the experience layer of an engagement is the hardest part of the problem, and when trustworthy, responsible AI needs an interface people actually trust. You'll operate at the intersection of individual client engagements - spanning DAX corporations to leading “Mittelstand” businesses - and appliedAI's broader design practice, working closely with adjacent teams such as Change & Enablement and Trustworthy AI to turn deep UX expertise into real-world impact.
Your tasks will include:

  • Own the user experience strategy across our most demanding client AI engagements - from discovery and early concept through validated, handover-ready designs that clients' engineering teams can build with confidence
  • Shape UX and CX strategy across engagements - framing the actual problem before a single screen is designed, running discovery and moderated research sessions with operators, planners, and engineers, so design decisions rest on evidence rather than opinion
  • Define the interaction patterns agentic systems need - human-in-the-loop approval, latency and status communication, source attribution, uncertainty and error states, and safe defaults for irreversible actions
  • Set the standard for how we design and modernize complex, operationally critical systems - dense data, high stakes, long-lived workflows, and users who cannot afford to guess what the system just did
  • Drive adoption of shared design systems and component libraries across engagements - specifications and patterns that make the next project faster, not a slide deck about consistency
  • Establish DesignOps and design governance across our project portfolio - methodologies, review rituals, and quality bars that scale experience maturity across multi-stakeholder programs, with accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA / EN 301 549) as a non-negotiable design requirement validated in close partnership with engineering
  • Own and evolve appliedAI's experience and design standards across the whole professional services organization, and raise the craft bar through review, critique, and mentoring


Your profile

  • Extensive experience, typically 10+ years, in experience design and design leadership, including leading or growing a multidisciplinary UX/design practice, with deep command of the end-to-end product design process from research through detailed interaction and visual design
  • Comfortable working at the boundary with engineering and being able to translate a design system into implementation-ready specifications and hold a high bar in review, without needing to ship production code yourself
  • A track record designing for complex, data-dense, operationally critical enterprise systems like industrial, infrastructure, control-room or comparable environments, delivered inside multi-stakeholder programs
  • Proven experience establishing DesignOps, governance models, and design methodologies that raise experience maturity beyond your own projects with designing systems, quality gates, and process frameworks that other teams actually adopt
  • Experience designing for AI or data-heavy products is a strong plus - non-deterministic output, latency, trust, and explainability change the design problem fundamentally
  • A trusted strategic advisor in ambiguous, client-facing settings, facilitating workshops, navigating conflicting stakeholder interests, and delivering difficult messages diplomatically, with the credibility to operate from C-suite conversations down to the operators who use the system
  • Fluent in English, German a strong plus as part of our client work happens in German

description_html:
Intro

Wir machen Unternehmensfinanzierung einfacher: digital, schnell und mit zunehmend intelligenten Lösungen. Mehr als 7.500 Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmer nutzen fulfin bereits.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Tech Teams suchen zum sofortigen Start einen Senior Engineer. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen Teams und übernimmst weitreichende Verantwortung für geschäftskritische Lösungen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst zuverlässige, wartbare Software.
  • Du übernimmst wichtige Projekte von der Problemdefinition bis zur Umsetzung und zum laufenden Betrieb.
  • Du hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und übersetzt geschäftliche und produktbezogene Anforderungen in wirkungsvolle, pragmatische technische Lösungen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Produktteam, der Geschäftsführung sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen.
  • Du unterstützt andere Entwickler und hilfst dabei, unsere technischen Standards und Arbeitsweisen weiterzuentwickeln.


Dein Profil

Anforderungen:

  • Du kommunizierst ausgezeichnet auf Englisch und kannst komplexe Themen technischen wie nicht-technischen Zielgruppen klar vermitteln.
  • Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, denkst kritisch, setzt klare Prioritäten und treibst Themen eigenverantwortlich bis zum Ergebnis voran. Dabei bist du neugierig und motiviert, dir fehlendes Wissen selbstständig anzueignen.
  • Du verfügst über ein solides Fundament in der Softwareentwicklung und praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb von Produktivsystemen.
  • Du kannst und möchtest überwiegend vor Ort in unserem Münchner Büro arbeiten.
Von Vorteil:
  • Du verfügst über professionelle Deutschkenntnisse.
  • Erfahrung in FinTech, Finanzdienstleistungen oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld.
  • Kenntnisse in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, AWS, Docker, Node.js, React, GraphQL, Serverless- oder ereignisgesteuerten Architekturen.
  • Erfahrung in einem kleinen Team mit breitem individuellem Verantwortungsbereich.
Du musst nicht jede genannte Technologie oder Branche kennen. Lernbereitschaft, Verantwortungsübernahme und klare Kommunikation sind uns wichtiger als ein perfekt passender Lebenslauf.


Benefits

title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)

description_html:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed.


Your Responsibilities

As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap: Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities.
  • Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments.
  • Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions.
  • Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls.
  • Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability.
  • Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution.
  • Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities.
  • Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
  • Administrators can complete common configuration and management tasks independently without requiring support tickets.
  • Time-to-value for new users is significantly reduced through enhanced onboarding and navigation experiences.
  • A clear, credible multi-year platform roadmap is established and supported by Engineering, Sales, and Leadership stakeholders.


Your Profile

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Product Manager within enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Experience owning and developing foundational product areas such as platform services, administrative experiences, developer portals, or similar infrastructure-related products.
  • Strong understanding of the needs of both IT buyers/administrators and end users.
  • Proven ability to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and drive execution in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Ability to build trust with engineering teams through clear problem definition, structured thinking, and pragmatic decision-making.
  • Experience navigating dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and turning complexity into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.


What’s in It for You

  • Join a profitable, growing software company with a strong global presence across Europe, North America, and APAC.
  • Play a key role in shaping the future of a rapidly scaling cloud platform used by thousands of organizations worldwide.
  • Work on high-impact platform experiences that influence how tens of thousands of users interact with Jedox every day.
  • Collaborate with talented international teams in a culture built around #OneTeam, innovation, and impactful results.
  • Enjoy the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to products that deliver real customer value.
  • Help define strategic platform decisions that will shape the Jedox experience for years to come.


Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence

As a tech-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes.
In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Your application is always reviewed by real people.
 
If you would like to learn more about the process, please visit the website of our partner Hi People. Here you will find information about the data protection guidelines as well as the most recent security checks. This gives you complete clarity on how your data is protected and processed. Of course, you can also contact us at any time if you have any questions.

title: Business Data Analyst Finance & Requirements Management (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aer Group
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben:

Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse, denkst analytisch und kannst komplexe Anforderungen verständlich strukturieren? Du bewegst Dich sicher zwischen Fachbereichen und technischen Teams und hast Freude daran, aus Daten und Anforderungen tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln? Dann suchen wir genau Dich als Business Data Analyst Finance & Requirements Management (m/w/d) in Teilzeit mit 30 Stunden pro Woche. In dieser Rolle bildest Du die Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Finance und technischen Teams und sorgst dafür, dass fachliche Anforderungen in erfolgreiche datenbasierte Lösungen übersetzt werden.

 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entgegennehmen, Strukturieren und fachliches Bewerten von Anforderungen aus Business, Finance, Controlling und angrenzenden Fachbereichen
  • Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen, Datenflüssen und fachlichen Use Cases mit Fokus auf buchhaltungsrelevante Vorgänge, Leistungsabrechnungen, Provisionsweitergaben und daraus resultierende Reporting-Anforderungen
  • Prüfung von Daten auf fachliche Plausibilität, Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Eignung für den jeweiligen Anwendungsfall
  • Erarbeitung und Dokumentation fachlicher Anforderungen sowie deren Übersetzung in umsetzbare technische Anforderungen
  • Erstellung von Fachkonzepten, Spezifikationen, Datenlogiken, Mapping-Dokumentationen, Akzeptanzkriterien und Testfällen
  • Abstimmung von Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Lösungsansätzen zwischen Fachbereichen und technischen Teams
  • Unterstützung bei der Qualitätssicherung sowie fachliche Validierung von umgesetzten Lösungen und Reports
  • Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen, Anforderungen und Datenstrukturen


Dein Profil:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Finance/Controlling, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Datenanalyse oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse kaufmännischer, finanzieller oder abrechnungsbezogener Daten
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Business Analysis, Requirements Engineering oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Business- und Finanzprozessen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Abrechnung, Reporting, Provisionen, Controlling oder Finanzwesen
  • Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen strukturiert aufzunehmen, kritisch zu hinterfragen, zu priorisieren und in klare Umsetzungsanforderungen zu überführen
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Datenstrukturen, Datenqualität und fachliche Datenmodellierung
  • Erfahrungen mit BI- und Reporting-Lösungen sowie Kenntnisse in SQL, Python oder vergleichbaren Skript- bzw. Programmiersprachen sind von Vorteil
  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenzubringen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

 


Warum wir:

  • Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig. Wir bieten deshalb eine flexible Home-Office-Regelung in individueller Absprache mit deinem Team Lead. Bis zu 30 Tage Workation pro Jahr sind bei uns ebenfalls möglich.
  • Bei uns gibt es nicht nur den üblichen Obstkorb sondern von Montag bis Freitag ein kostenloses, frisch gekochtes Mittagessen (Bio und regional) in unserer eigenen Kantine am Standort Berlin. Alle Kollegen an den anderen Standorten bekommen alternativ Pluxee Gutscheine.
  • Wir arbeiten in einem zentral gelegenem Loft-Office in Berlin Kreuzberg mit viel Platz zum gemeinsamen Austausch und Netzwerken.
  • Wir zahlen Dir monatlich einen ÖPNV-Zuschuss von 50 Euro.
  • Wir bieten einen Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen: Bei uns kommt wöchentlich ein Masseur (Massagen inkl. Zuschuss vom Arbeitgeber) und wir veranstalten viele gemeinsame Team- und Firmenevents, vom Bowling übers Sommerfest bis zu selbst organisierten Kurzreisen.
  • Bei uns bekommst du branchenübliche Rabatte für dein Wochenende oder deinen Familienurlaub (z. B. günstige Flüge, Zugtickets, Hotelübernachtungen oder sogar ganze Urlaubspakete).
  • Unser Sustainability-Team freut sich auf deine Ideen für mehr Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz im Unternehmen.

title: Working Student | Accounting & Finance (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at TWAICE
description_html:
About the role

As renewable energy reshapes the global power system, batteries are taking center stage. Making them safe, reliable, and bankable at scale is a defining challenge of the energy transition. At TWAICE, our software turns battery data into insights - so decisions are made with confidence, not guesswo​​​​rk.

We're accelerating the transition into a new energy era and we're looking for those who want to move fast with us.

As a Working Student in our Finance Team, you’ll be involved in day-to-day operations, take on real ownership, and see firsthand how decisions shape the company. You won’t just observe; you'll play an active role in keeping the business running and growing.

This position has the potential to become a permanent role upon graduation.

Working hours and days are flexible (particularly around exams). You should be available for at least 15 hours per week and be able to come into our central Munich HQ once per week - though you're welcome to come in daily if you'd like.


Your daily business will involve

  • Take the lead on parts of Accounts Payable through Spendesk for our German and US entities - checking invoices for correctness under HGB/US-GAAP, applying the correct accounts and cost centers, and preparing payments for approvals.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities by coordinating input from internal stakeholders and tax advisors - ensuring expenses are accurately recorded, supporting documentation and receipts are complete, and all required entries are properly booked and reconciled.
  • Support monthly financial reporting, including cost and budget tracking.
  • Own the documentation of how our finance processes work. Prepare guides that our auditors, tax advisors and your colleagues will rely on.
BONUS TOPICS:
  • Help manage and optimize expense management & budgets using Spendesk
  • Support Accounts Receivable, including order processing, invoicing, and revenue recognition
  • Contribute to process optimization and tool improvements within Finance


Your profile

  • Enrolled student in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a comparable field 
  • Hands-on mindset: you spot what needs to be done, take ownership of it, and deliver reliable results 
  • Comfortable working with financial data & spreadsheets
  • Strong communication skills: you convey information clearly and in the right level of detail for internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong interest in practical accounting work and basic knowledge of accounting principles (HGB, US-GAAP)
  • Interest in tax, cost, and budget reporting
  • Fluent in English (must-have) and German (B2 level) 
  • First exposure to DATEV, QuickBooks, or Spendesk is a plus
Please consider that the requirements are not listed in order of importance, and we know it is nearly impossible to tick every box. If you can see yourself making a valuable contribution at TWAICE, we’d be delighted to receive your application regardless.


What we offer

  • Hands-on experience in Accounting & Finance at a global scale-up
  • Close collaboration with experienced finance professionals
  • High responsibility from day one and a steep learning curve
  • Central Munich office, hybrid setup, and flexible working hours
  • €16 (Bachelor's) to €18 (Master's) per hour
  • Potential for a permanent role after graduation


Follow along

See what TWAICE is up to https://www.linkedin.com/company/twaice/

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at TWAICE
description_html:
About the role

As renewable energy reshapes the global power system, batteries are taking center stage. Making them safe, reliable, and bankable at scale is a defining challenge of the energy transition. At TWAICE, our software turns battery data into insights - so decisions are made with confidence, not guesswork.

We're accelerating the transition into a new energy era and we're looking for those who want to move fast with us.

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will be working in our product teams to create customer value at a high pace. This includes taking part in the full product development cycle, from understanding user problems and shaping solutions to building and iterating on them. You will work in a team with backgrounds in Software and Battery Engineering – creating solutions to get our projects from definition to customer value quickly while making sure we deliver robust, scalable, and extensible software products.
Together, we will push our battery analytics to the next level.


Your daily business will involve

  • Contribute to and help shape the feature set of our SaaS product in incremental and result-oriented steps
  • Implement new software components across the stack, from our backend services to our API layer and frontend serving customers across industries
  • Take ownership of features and parts of the product – from refinement through implementation to maintenance – with guidance from the senior engineers in your team
  • Continuously ship code to production through our CI/CD process and apply monitoring and observability best practices to make sure everything runs smoothly
  • Grow your craft with us: pair with experienced engineers, contribute to code reviews and take part in regular cross-team knowledge sharing


Your profile

  • Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience
  • Around 1–4 years of professional experience building and running software in production
  • Comfortable across the stack – for example TypeScript/Python on the backend and Angular, React, or a comparable framework on the frontend
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested code
  • Collaborative working style – code reviews, knowledge sharing, open feedback
  • Curiosity about battery technology and energy storage, even without prior exposure
Good to have
  • Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform, and building RESTful APIs
  • Exposure to timeseries data or data visualization tools

We know it is nearly impossible to tick every box. If you can see yourself making a valuable contribution at TWAICE, we’d be delighted to receive your application regardless.


What we offer

  • Flexible Working: We trust you to get the job done. Deliver your best work with options to work remotely, onsite or hybrid. Everyone comes together at our Munich HQ twice a year.
  • Equity Participation: Every employee is offered a stock-option plan so you can share in TWAICE’s success.
  • Perks: Borrow our Company EVs for private use, power-up with subsidized fitness memberships (Wellpass), enjoy active transport with JobRad, invest in your future with 100% matched company pension scheme, co-working network access


Follow along

See what TWAICE is up to https://www.linkedin.com/company/twaice/

Your mission:

  • Preparation of market analyses, economic assessments and expert reports for PV, BESS and hybrid projects
  • Analysis of electricity markets, market mechanisms and regulatory frameworks within the European energy sector
  • Evaluation of business models, route-to-market strategies, as well as flexibility and energy storage solutions
  • Conducting cash flow, sensitivity and scenario analyses to support investment decisions
  • Presentation of results and strategic recommendations to clients, investors and project partners
  • Further development of existing consulting products and creation of new services in the field of Energy Markets & Economics
  • Collaboration in an international environment and close coordination with the Sales and Business Development teams


Your profile:

  • Successfully completed degree in Energy Economics, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Business Administration or a comparable field of study
  • Several years of professional experience in the energy sector, market analysis, management consulting or project development
  • In-depth knowledge of European electricity markets, energy market dynamics and regulatory requirements
  • Experience in developing financial models, economic assessments and data-driven decision-making frameworks
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to structure complex topics and communicate them effectively to different target audiences
  • High level of initiative, accountability, customer orientation and entrepreneurial mindset
  • Excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken


You can look forward to:

6 reasons to join meteocontrol (and more):

  • You take strategic responsibility for a defined portfolio of mid-sized national and international B2B customers in the photovoltaic and BESS sectors, with a focus on revenue, margin, growth and long-term customer retention.

  • You have several years of experience in strategic account management, B2B sales or managing complex customer relationships.
  • You have a proven track record of developing long-term customer relationships and growing existing accounts, ideally with responsibility for revenue, margins or growth targets.
  • You have experience negotiating complex proposals and contracts at decision-maker level and managing demanding sales processes.
  • Knowledge of photovoltaics, BESS and/or network technology is an advantage and will help you get up to speed quickly.

title: Product Owner (m/w/d) - Customer Domain
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at doctari GmbH
description_html:
Über uns

Seit 2008 arbeiten wir mit unseren vier Marken doctari, lichtfeld, Planerio und arztpool an unserer Vision, medizinisches Personal dorthin zu bringen, wo es am dringendsten benötigt wird.

doctari pro ist unsere B2B-Buchungsplattform für Personalverantwortliche in Krankenhäusern und Gesundheitseinrichtungen und die zentrale Schnittstelle zur Demand-Seite unseres Marktplatzes. Über doctari pro können Ärztinnen und Ärzte unkompliziert gefunden, angefragt und gebucht werden: in Arbeitnehmerüberlassung oder befristeter Anstellung. Als Gegenstück zur doctari App auf der Kandidatenseite ist doctari pro ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres zweiseitigen Marktplatzes.


Deine neue Rolle

Als Product Owner (m/w/d) im Customer Domain Team übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Wachstumshebel unseres Unternehmens. Gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team gestaltest du die Produktstrategie ebenso aktiv mit wie die Umsetzung neuer Features und bringst moderne Technologien wie KI gezielt in die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro ein. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering, UX Design und internen Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst fundierte Produktentscheidungen auf Basis von Nutzerdaten, technischen Anforderungen und Marktanforderungen.

  • Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team innovative Features für Kliniken und Gesundheitseinrichtungen, von der Anfrage bis zur Buchung.

  • Du priorisierst das Product Backlog anhand von Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktanforderungen und relevanten Produkt-KPIs.

  • Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der Product Discovery über Delivery bis zum erfolgreichen Release.

  • Du arbeitest mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen und übersetzt Marktanforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen.

  • Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Buchungsdaten, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und optimierst kontinuierlich die Customer Journey auf doctari pro.

  • Du treibst den gezielten Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Produkt voran.


Deine Erfahrung & Persönlichkeit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS-, Plattform- oder Marketplace-Umfeld.

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte für Geschäftskunden: von der Product Discovery über nutzerzentriertes Design bis zur datengetriebenen Optimierung.

  • Technisches Verständnis, das tief genug geht, um Architekturentscheidungen zu verstehen, Trade-offs zu bewerten und mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren.

  • Analytisches Denken, Pragmatismus sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Produkte und moderne Technologien, die du aktiv nutzt, um Produktmehrwert zu schaffen.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Account Management oder Customer Success ist ein klares Plus.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.


Das erwartet Dich

Bei uns übernimmst du echte Produktverantwortung für doctari pro, eine Plattform mit direktem Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität im deutschen Gesundheitssystem. Du gestaltest die Demand-Seite eines der größten medizinischen Marktplätze Deutschlands mit und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit unmittelbar in den Daten.

Darüber hinaus bieten wir eine Vielzahl an Benefits und Möglichkeiten, um Berufliches wie Privates gut zu vereinen:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Vertrauensarbeitszeit
  • Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
  • Rabatte über Corporate Benefits
  • Zuschuss zum EGYM Wellpass


Komm zu uns!

Du hast Interesse mehr zu erfahren oder Lust auf diese Stelle, dann sende uns deinen Lebenslauf inklusive Gehaltsvorstellung und dem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin gleich hier. Offene Fragen beantwortet ich dir Maria, Recruiting Manager, gerne unter 01516 3304090. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

description_html:

  • Du unterstützt die langfristige Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung unserer Plattform – mit Blick auf Stabilität, Performance, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit.
  • Du begleitest Projekte und Produkte bis in den produktiven Betrieb und stellst gemeinsam mit den Teams einen zuverlässigen laufenden Betrieb sicher.

  • Du kennst dich mit Datenbanken, APIs und dem gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess aus – von der technischen Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Betrieb.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung sowie im Coaching und in der Weiterentwicklung von Software Engineers.

title: Principal Brand Designer (Spain or Portugal - based role)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Olx
description_html:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.


What you'll own

Define the future of OLX’s  Group's brand ecosystem

Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across  product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.


    What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust 

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design 

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills


    • Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.


    Hiring Process
    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
     
    First Stage 
    Portfolio & Design Leadership 
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage 
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership 
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage 
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact 
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

    Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX
    OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!
     
    Data Process Policy
     
    OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.
